articles.title: Artemis
articles.summary: Artemis was the dominant war alliance of the 2020 territory map, founded on 30 October 2019 by Imperial, Paladins United and Caeruleum Order. Its roster transformed almost completely across 2020 — by December both surviving founders were attested on the opposing side — and it collapsed on 11 May 2021 together with its rival Goose.
articles.body:
**Artemis** was the dominant war alliance of the 2020 territory map. Founded on 30 October 2019 by [[Imperial]], [[Paladins United]] and Caeruleum Order, it transformed almost completely over the following year — by December 2020 both of its surviving founders were attested on the opposing side — and it collapsed on 11 May 2021 together with its rival [[Goose]], in what became known as [[the-great-collapse|The Great Collapse]].

## History

### Founding
Artemis was formed on 30 October 2019, in the aftermath of the [[Terra]] bloc's fall, by Imperial, Paladins United and Caeruleum Order. On 10 November 2019 fragments of the collapsed Terra launched a final raid on the newborn alliance. Nightingales and Phantom Hearts joined within days of the founding.

No founding announcement was ever posted, and the founder guilds' own leadership at that moment is known only in fragments. Caeruleum Order — founded on 10 September 2018 and self-described as "a democratic, fully parliamentary guild" — was run by a four-member Caeruleum Parliament of MultiSmith, 1917Lenin1917, StormPh0enix and StarlyNight; its thread records the guild passing from [[Luna]] to Artemis, its alliance line reading "We are a part of the Luna Alliance" in the body while listing "Artemis Alliance" as the current bloc. Carrie spoke for Paladins United in the same period.

### The 2020 transformation
No Artemis membership list was published between November 2019 and December 2020, and the alliance that emerged from that gap looked very different from the one that entered it. By 9 March 2020 [[Kingdom Foxes]] publicly identified itself as a member, and [[ShadowFall]] held a leadership seat: on that day [[goulartjj|GoulartJJ]] posted "as the Shadow Fall leader and one of Artemis leaders", defending the alliance against the charge that it froze small guilds out. His account of ShadowFall's own rise doubles as a description of how Artemis worked — the guild had grown to "level 20ish by August of last year" through free-for-all territory grinding after "we tried joining Luna when we were leveling but got denied" — and he set out the alliance's two working rules: "Guilds who are with big claims are the guilds who have contributed the most to the alliance", and "Guilds may also apply to Artemis by contacting one of the guild leaders, and possibly be accepted." By 2 December 2020 the [[the-forum-megalist|forum megalist]] described Artemis as "the war alliance made up of all the current massive land holding guilds on the map", naming [[Titans Valor]] as a member.

The founders, meanwhile, had drifted out: a conflict thread of 18 December 2020 places both Paladins United and Imperial with the unnamed anti-Artemis coalition that would take the name Goose. When and why they left was never recorded; map-data analysis places their departures near the start of December 2020, when that coalition's war on the Artemis core ignited. All recorded joins from this period are "by" dates, and the intermediate 2020 roster remains a documented gap.

### The Goose war and collapse
From December 2020 Artemis defended its map dominance in the [[goose-artemis-war|Goose-Artemis war]]. The bleed of members continued into the new year — "BNU(IBT), SHY and TNL are all goose now", a megalist post recorded on 1 February 2021, marking ShadowFall's switch to the enemy. On 25 January 2021 the two blocs jointly granted [[Profession Heaven]] neutral status as a public profession-XP guild. Artemis was still on the offensive in February 2021 ("Artemis guilds warring the Rays-held desert", a thread of 20 February records), and took late reinforcements — Sins of Seedia in March 2021, [[Aequitas]] and Wheres The Finish in early May — but on 11 May 2021 Artemis and Goose collapsed on the same day.

## Membership
The recorded roster merges the documented founding era with the attested 2020–2021 membership; several dates are "by" dates rather than exact joins, and the roster between November 2019 and December 2020 was never published.

{{alliance:Artemis}}

## Legacy
Artemis gave its name to the [[artemis-goose-era|Artemis-Goose era]]. Its final membership fed both successor blocs of The Great Collapse: Titans Valor went into [[Valhalla]], while the late joiners Aequitas and Wheres The Finish co-founded [[Khaos]] the same day. The joint protection of Profession Heaven outlived both blocs, maintained by their successors until 2026.

## Sources

- Wynncraft forums thread 263975, post #36 (GoulartJJ, 9 Mar 2020: "as the Shadow Fall leader and one of Artemis leaders") and Carrie's posts on page 3

- Wynncraft forums thread 278112 ("the megalist"), posts of 2 Dec 2020 and 1 Feb 2021, via Wayback Machine snapshots

articles.title: Aurelion
articles.summary: Aurelion was a four-guild community alliance formed in February 2017 around House of Sentinels, with Hippies of Snuggles, The Dark Phoenix and Dragons Arise joining over the following fortnight. It ran its own Discord and is last attested in April 2017; no war activity is recorded for it.
articles.body:
**Aurelion** was a community alliance of early 2017 built around House of Sentinels. It is attested from a single place — the alliance block of the House of Sentinels recruitment thread — but that block is unusually precise, giving a dated join for every member, which makes Aurelion the only [[early-guild-era|early guild era]] alliance whose membership timeline is recorded to the day.

## History

House of Sentinels, founded on 2 July 2016 and describing itself as "a place of respite for those who need it", carried the line "House of Sentinels is a member guild of Aurelion, a community alliance" in its thread, above four dated entries:

| Guild | Joined |
|---|---|
| House of Sentinels | 14 Feb 2017 |
| Hippies of Snuggles | 15 Feb 2017 |
| The Dark Phoenix | 26 Feb 2017 |
| Dragons Arise | 27 Feb 2017 |

The alliance ran a Discord server open enough that outsiders used it as a point of contact: an applicant to House of Sentinels wrote on 30 April 2017 that "when I went on the Aurelion Discord, I asked if I could claim refugee status and someone told me to apply" — the last attestation of Aurelion anywhere, and an indication that it was still operating that spring.

House of Sentinels' subsequent history is much better recorded than the alliance's. Its 2017 council was Pyrias, Pretzule, wrxryuu, [[killerfish|Killerfish]], ChaChaChaChino and 01100110111; by 30 April 2017 Pretzule led it and it had begun "focusing on warring with other guilds and maintaining territory"; and it went on to become one of the four founding guilds of the [[coalition|Coalition]] in October 2017.

## Membership

The four guilds above are the complete attested membership. Neither a founding thread nor a leadership structure for Aurelion has been recovered, and no source names who led it. Aurelion predates the machine-recorded chronicle, which begins in January 2018, so no live membership card exists for it.

An earlier note in this project's research corpus placed Aurelion in 2016, on the assumption that the House of Sentinels thread text dated from the thread's opening in July 2016. The dated join list places the alliance in February 2017, and the thread's opening post carries revisions through April 2017; February 2017 is the reading followed here.

## Legacy

Aurelion left no record of warring, no dissolution notice and no successor. Its interest lies in what it says about the road to the Coalition: seven months before that alliance was founded, its future core guild was already the anchor of a small community bloc with its own Discord, recruiting refugees from collapsing guilds. Dragons Arise appears in the same period as a member of another community alliance, Lux Imperius, listed in UltimateXeons' thread — an illustration of how loosely these 2016-17 community pacts overlapped.

## Sources

- Wynncraft forums thread 135191 ("House Of Sentinels - Aurelion Guild"), opening post as last revised 29 Apr 2017 — the Aurelion self-description, the four dated member entries, the 2 Jul 2016 founding and 2017 council
- Wynncraft forums thread 187152 ("House Of Sentinels - Community & War Guild"), post #20 (Ahpi, 30 Apr 2017) — "the Aurelion Discord"; opening post (Pretzule) on the shift to warring
- Wynncraft forums thread 109350 ("Ultimate Xeons"), opening post, "Old alliances" section — Lux Imperius roster including Dragons Arise

articles.title: Avocado Aquarium
articles.summary: Avocado Aquarium was the two-guild war pact of Avicia and The Aquarium after they quit smtn elf in June 2023, waging a sniping and claim-taking campaign against their former allies into early 2024. The pair ran shared infrastructure including the joint subguild Avoquarium [HQs]; the pact's name survives only in testimony.
articles.body:
**Avocado Aquarium** was the two-guild war pact of [[Avicia]] and [[The Aquarium]], formed when both quit [[smtn elf]] in June 2023. The pair waged a sniping and claim-taking campaign against their former allies into early 2024.

## History
The name itself survives only in oral-history testimony — it appears nowhere in writing. The relationship it names is well attested. After [[the-avocado-split|the Avocado split]] of June 2023, in which the two guilds rejected pressure to shrink their territorial claims and walked out of smtn elf, they ran a joint campaign against their ex-allies; Avicia's Season 13 post of 19 August 2023 calls The Aquarium “our unwavering ally and neighbour”.

The pact ran shared infrastructure. The joint subguild Avoquarium [HQs] was created on 9 August 2023 per the official API — Avicia's June season post already thanks its allies “for the hqs” — alongside the subguilds [[ShadowFall]] (The Aquarium's) and the Avos (Avicia's), across which the pair ran mega-claims. During the pact Avicia also fought the rising [[Sequoia]] in the [[avicia-sequoia-war|Avicia-Sequoia war]] (October–November 2023, with a second round in January 2024).

No formal end was ever recorded. Map-data analysis shows the joint campaign fading by early 2024, and the chronicle's end date of February 2024 is an approximation from that fade, matching testimony that the campaign ran “into early 2024”. The first friction between the two guilds themselves appears only in June 2024, after the pact had lapsed.

## Membership
{{alliance:Avocado Aquarium}}

## Legacy
Avocado Aquarium is the emblem of the [[private-diplomacy-era|private-diplomacy era]]: a consequential alliance whose very name was never written down while it existed, recoverable only through testimony, season posts and map data. Within months of its fade its members stood at the center of the era's biggest wars — The Aquarium against [[Idiot Co]] in the [[idiot-co-aquarium-war|Idiot Co-Aquarium war]] from April 2024.

## Sources
- oral-history testimony (Cameron, TAq veteran): the pact's name and story
- Avicia Season 12 post, thread 308780 (10 Jun 2023); Avicia Season 13 post, thread 310286 (19 Aug 2023)
- official Wynncraft API (Avoquarium [HQs] guild creation, 9 Aug 2023)
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (joint-campaign window and fade)

articles.summary: The Coalition was the dominant Wynncraft war alliance of late 2017, founded in October 2017 by Kingdom Foxes, KingdomPhoenixes, Gilded Sparrows and House of Sentinels. It took full control of the map by Christmas 2017 and shattered in February 2018, its fracture producing both Alliance Alliance and the Federation.

articles.body:
The **Coalition** (tag **Coa**; called "The 1st Coalition" in the community Timeline document) was a Wynncraft war alliance active from October 2017 to February 2018. Founded by [[Kingdom Foxes]], KingdomPhoenixes, Gilded Sparrows and House of Sentinels, it conquered the entire territory map by the end of 2017, and its fracture in February 2018 produced both [[Alliance Alliance]] and [[the-federation|the Federation]] — the two sides of the [[coalition-civil-war|Coalition Civil War]].

## History

### The founders
No founding thread for the Coalition exists. The forums were searched by alliance name, by founder guild and through a Wayback CDX sweep of 19,659 archived Wynncraft thread URLs, and no Coalition announcement post of any kind was recovered; by late 2017 alliance diplomacy had moved to Discord. The founding is therefore dated only by the community guild-timeline image — "October 2017, Coalition is created" — with no day given.

The four founding guilds can nonetheless be described from their own threads, and two of them were barely older than the alliance:

- **KingdomPhoenixes** [PHX], led by [[aurumkitsune|AurumKitsune]] as "Queen of the Phoenixes", was "officially established" on 23 Sep 2017 — one month before the Coalition — and described itself as having "arose from the ashes of a dead guild".
- **Gilded Sparrows**, founded by [[killerfish|Killerfish]] and announced on 17 Nov 2017, was newer still: "Founded in the midst of autumn... although the guild itself is taking its first steps, its leader is not a novice at what he does."
- **House of Sentinels**, founded 2 Jul 2016 by Pyrias, was led by Pretzule from at least Apr 2017; its thread that spring recorded a deliberate turn toward warring — "Due to a few reasons our guild will also be focusing on warring with other guilds and maintaining territory" — after a year as a community guild in the [[aurelion|Aurelion]] alliance.
- **[[Kingdom Foxes]]** is the oldest of the four, founded in 2014 and a co-founder of [[Valkyrie]] in 2015 under [[lovelusting|LoveLusting]]. [[drew1011|Drew1011]]'s profile records him as "King of the Foxes" from 1 Dec 2016 to 7 Feb 2017 and "Viceroy of the Foxes" from Feb 2017 to Feb 2019; who held the kingship during the Coalition period is named in no source.

The founders were one social circle before they were an alliance. Killerfish sat on House of Sentinels' founding council in 2016 alongside Pyrias and Pretzule, and had helped write the [[halcyon|Halcyon]] alliance thread that June alongside Drew1011; Drew1011 posted congratulations on both the KingdomPhoenixes and the Gilded Sparrows announcement threads ("Good luck with your guild... they grow up so fast"). What the record shows of the Coalition's origins is a network of people who had been founding each other's guilds and alliances for eighteen months, rather than a negotiated compact between strangers.

### Rise to map dominance
The Coalition took control of the Wynn Province on 23 Nov 2017, and that December it destroyed [[war-syndicate|War Syndicate]] — "they wiped ws off the map on Christmas day," as one participant recalled in a 2020 retrospective — gaining full map dominance. Another participant disputed the wipe in the same thread, holding that the two blocs merged instead; both readings are set out on the War Syndicate page.

### The split
On 16–17 Feb 2018 (the community guild-timeline image dates the split to the 16th, the Timeline document to the 17th), five member guilds — [[HackForums]], [[Paladins United]], House of Sentinels, [[Emorians]] and Kangronomicon — left over map disputes and formed [[Alliance Alliance]] together with [[Fantasy]] and Necronomicon, declaring war on their former alliance and beginning the [[coalition-civil-war|Coalition Civil War]]. The Coalition remnant merged with War Syndicate's remains into the new [[the-federation|Federation]], ending the Coalition as an entity; the civil war itself ran until the Federation took control of the map on 20 Mar 2018.

Even the genealogy was disputed among participants. A 2020 retrospective states plainly that "Coa and WS merged... this was a creation of fed", while [[slayne|Slayne]] wrote in 2018: "I created Fed because I (along with some others) created Double AA."

### Record caveats
The Coalition predates the territory-exchange record, which begins in January 2018: recorded membership dates are clamped to that boundary, the guilds' real join dates are unrecorded, and the membership of the five departing guilds is inferred from their documented February 2018 departures rather than from recorded joins. The alliance's earlier history survives only in forum accounts of other subjects and in the community timeline.

## Membership
{{alliance:Coalition}}

## Legacy
Both of the great blocs of 2018 descend from the Coalition: Alliance Alliance from its defectors, and the Federation from its remnant. The Federation went on to hold the entire map for nearly nine months, defining the [[federation-era|Federation era]] — and the Coalition's brief, total dominance became the template every later map-holding alliance would be measured against. It was also the last major alliance of the [[early-guild-era|early guild era]] to leave no thread of its own: from 2018 onward the blocs announced themselves on the forums again, which is why the record after it is so much thicker than the record before.

## Sources
- Community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ), recovered via Wynncraft forums thread 265297 — "October 2017, Coalition is created"; the February 2018 split
- Wynncraft forums thread 265297, retrospective posts of Apr 2020 (Lego_DW on the Coa–WS merger; IceResistance on the Christmas Day wipe of War Syndicate)
- Wynncraft forums thread 204381 ("Kingdom Of Phoenixes"), opening post by AurumKitsune, thread opened 24 Sep 2017 — establishment on 23 Sep 2017, leadership
- Wynncraft forums thread 208566 ("Gilded Sparrows"), opening post by Killerfish, 17 Nov 2017, and post #3 (Drew1011, 17 Nov 2017)
- Wynncraft forums threads 135191 and 187152 ("House Of Sentinels") — founding 2 Jul 2016, the 2016 council including Killerfish, Pretzule's leadership, the turn toward warring
- Wynncraft forums thread 130444 ("Halcyon Alliance", 8 Jun 2016) — Killerfish and Drew1011 in the same circle
- Drew1011's forum profile title chain — King and Viceroy of the Foxes, 2016–2019
- Wayback CDX sweep of forums.wynncraft.com thread slugs (19,659 URLs) — no Coalition founding thread exists
- Community Timeline document (chronicle research corpus)
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (2018 window boundary)

articles.title: Council of Canyon Kingdoms
articles.summary: The Council of Canyon Kingdoms (CCK or CoCK) was a Wynncraft war alliance of autumn 2019, formed on 15 Sep 2019 by seven guilds of the victorious Terra bloc. It collapsed on 23 Nov 2019 when The Ascendancy bloc departed, two days after Titans Valor and DiamondDeities left.
articles.body:
The **Council of Canyon Kingdoms** (tag **CoCK**, also written CCK) was a Wynncraft war alliance of autumn 2019, formed by the victors of the [[Luna]]–[[Terra]] war and dissolved ten weeks later.

## History

### Formation
The Council formed on 15 Sep 2019, a week after Terra took the map from Luna, by seven guilds of the victorious Terra bloc: [[Kingdom Foxes]], [[DiamondDeities]], [[Titans Valor]], [[The Simple Ones]], [[Fantasy]], Phantom Hearts and Empire of Sindria.

### Course
Phantom Hearts abandoned the Council at an undated point in September–October 2019; the chronicle approximates its exit to 1 Oct, noting that exchange data is inconclusive on the split (Phantom Hearts went on to join [[Artemis]] on 4 Nov). TheNoLifes joined on 28 Sep, BlueStoneGroup on 10 Oct and Vindicator on 14 Oct, bringing the Council to its peak of nine concurrent members. Kingdom Foxes departed on 1 Nov, the eve of [[Terra]]'s formal fall.

### Collapse
The Council collapsed on 23 Nov 2019 after The Ascendancy bloc departed, two days after Titans Valor and DiamondDeities left. The Ascendancy itself — created 27 Apr 2019 per the community timeline — left no recorded roster anywhere. A week later, on 1 Dec, DiamondDeities, Titans Valor and The Simple Ones regrouped as [[Horologium]].

## Membership
{{alliance:Council of Canyon Kingdoms}}

## Legacy
The Council was the first of the short-lived successor blocs that followed the [[the-alliance-wars-of-2019|Alliance Wars of 2019]] — none of Terra's heirs held together for more than a few months, and the map stabilized only with [[Artemis]]'s rise from 30 Oct 2019. Its own direct successor, Horologium, lasted five weeks.

## Sources
- Community Timeline document — founding roster, departures, collapse
- Community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ), via forums thread 265297 — The Ascendancy's creation date
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis — the inconclusive Phantom Hearts exit signal

articles.title: Cucumber Company
articles.summary: Cucumber Company was the war alliance of the great 2022 realignment, merging the ex-Valhalla and ex-Khaos worlds into a fourteen-guild bloc formed for guild Season 5. Its roster, posted to the forum megalist on 26 June 2022, was the last public alliance roster ever; it was archived and renamed 'Smtn else' at the start of Season 8.
articles.body:
**Cucumber Company** was the war alliance of the great 2022 realignment, merging the ex-[[Valhalla]]/[[Vanir]] and ex-[[Khaos]] worlds into a single fourteen-guild bloc. Its roster, posted to the forum megalist on 26 June 2022, is the last public alliance roster ever recorded; the alliance was archived and renamed “Smtn else” at the start of guild Season 8 in autumn 2022.

## History

### Formation
The exact formation date is undocumented. The war between Khaos and the ex-Valhalla guilds was still running in January 2022, and [[titan-times|Titan Times]] vol. 1 (8 May 2022) records “our first season being a part of the new Cucumber Company war alliance” — placing the founding around the start of guild Season 5 in spring 2022. Map data corroborates the merge timing: exchanges between the ex-Khaos and ex-Valhalla guilds flip from war-shaped to ally-shaped trading in May–June 2022.

### The last public roster
On 26 June 2022 a member (TherapueticLiz of Sins of Seedia) posted the full fourteen-guild roster to the [[the-forum-megalist|megalist]]: [[Aequitas]], [[Titans Valor]], [[Avicia]], Blacklisted, KongoBoys, Empire of Sindria, Gang of Fools, [[Kingdom Foxes]], The Clowns, Nefarious Ravens, Sins of Seedia, [[The Aquarium]], Wynn Legacy and [[Profession Heaven]]. Twelve days later the megalist's alliance section was deleted, and no public alliance roster was ever posted again. Independent corroboration survives in software: Titans Valor's Discord bot consumed an alliance-claims feed built on Avicia's site code between April and December 2022 — the two guilds sharing alliance infrastructure exactly in this window.

Membership shifted at the edges. IceBlue Team was a founding member that had left by 12 June 2022; Gang of Fools joined that same month; and Kingdom Foxes' exit is map-dated to around July 2022, when it entered sustained war with bloc guilds. The Fox and Gang of Fools stints should be read cautiously — both appear on the June roster yet fought bloc guilds in adjacent months.

### Rename
At the start of Season 8 (autumn 2022), “Cucumber was archived. The new alliance name is called Smtn else”, per Titan Times vol. 6 — the same issue that records Gang of Fools having “left and betrayed the alliance”. The bloc's history continues under [[smtn elf]].

## Membership
Joins are approximated to the Season 5 boundary; the roster is attested as of 26 June 2022.

{{alliance:Cucumber Company}}

## Legacy
Cucumber Company ended the two-bloc war era of 2021 by absorbing both sides, and its June 2022 roster post became a historical landmark by accident: the deletion of the megalist's alliance section twelve days later marks the start of the [[private-diplomacy-era|private-diplomacy era]], in which alliances ceased to be publicly recorded.

## Sources
- Titan Times vol. 1 (8 May 2022) and vol. 3 (12 Jun 2022)
- Wynncraft forums thread 278112 (“the megalist”), page 8 posts #160 (26 Jun 2022) and #161 (7 Jul 2022)
- titantimes/valor repository commit history (Apr–Dec 2022 alliance-claims feed)
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (merge timing; Kingdom Foxes' exit)

It is the largest alliance of the pre-Coalition era with a surviving written roster, and the community guild timeline dates its fall to 17 October 2017.

articles.body:
The **Emperium of Wynn** (TEoW) was a Wynncraft alliance of 2017, founded on 21 April and dissolved that October. It is the best-documented alliance of the [[early-guild-era|early guild era]]: its forum thread preserves a full member roster with each guild's leader, a written constitution of offices, and — inside the quoted text of the original opening post — an earlier roster from four months before, making it the only pre-2018 alliance whose membership can be watched changing over time.

## History

The alliance thread (Wynncraft forums thread 188024) was opened on 7 May 2017 by Paladin A'renos: "The Emperium of Wynn (TEoW) is a Dynamic alliance that was formed on the 21st of April with the goal of uniting guilds of all levels and experience to create a more user-friendly experience." Its stated order of business put community ahead of war — "As a fairly new alliance, our first goal is to get connected with our community. Events, giveaways, dungeon runs... After that, we plan on bringing in the war aspect of any alliance" — though the rules also provided for "aggressive extermination" of guilds found to be bullying members, and asked members to "refrain from taking lands from small guilds".

The May 2017 roster survives because Yuno F Gasai quoted the opening post in full on 7 May (post #4). It listed ten guilds — [[libertas|Libertas]], UltimateXeons, NeoPancakes, Sinners, The Mage Legacy, Wynn Theory, Boom, BuildCraftia, Shadow Kittens and LE Flowers — with Beasts and Jaguars pending, and only one filled leadership portfolio (War Leader DownDeeper). By the time the opening post was last revised in August 2017 the roster had turned over almost completely and every office was staffed.

## Government

The Emperator was "the main figure head and the leader of the Emperium of Wynn... Their word is law within the alliance". Beneath the Emperator sat a War Leader (territory allocation, guild banks, war games), a Community Leader (to be chosen by community poll), and an Economy Leader. A High Council of one to three representatives per guild voted on rule changes, leadership changes and admissions; Judges ruled on rule-breaking, and their word could not be over-ruled. Accepted guilds swore an "Oath of the Shadow Advisor". A Buddy System let member guilds sponsor sub-guilds and lend them territory, and the constitution capped any single alliance at 10–15 guilds, requiring an overflow of five or more to be spun off as a "Brother Alliance" under its own Emperator.

## Membership

The roster as the thread was last revised (August 2017), with the leader named for each guild:

| Guild | Tag | Leader |
|---|---|---|
| UltimateXeons | UXs | motoki1 |
| Sinners | Snr | Rani and DownDeeper |
| LE Flowers | LEF | MarcosSegon |
| The No Lifes | TNL | chownick |
| IceBlueTeam | IBT | orkrider |
| TheForsaken | fsn | joshaftel |
| Beasts | Bst | Beastovrlrd |
| The Divine Souls | DsO | _Shirou_ |
| TitanZ | TTZ | SiuChau |
| [[titans-valor|Titans Valor]] | ANO | IceResistance |
| Silent Heroes | SLH | SkyVirus |
| Sins of Seedia | SDU | [[simplyinfinity|simplyinfinity_]] |

Leadership at that date: Emperator [[nitrogen2oxygen|Nitrogen2Oxygen]], War Leader _Shirou_, Community Leader joshaftel, Economy Leader Angry_Will, Judges Meekio, Nitrogen2Oxygen, Lestrade and joshaftel.

The same revision listed eleven "Honored Retired Guilds" — NeoPancakes, The Mage Legacy, Wynn Theory, Void of Amnesia, Jaguars, Boom, Shadow Kittens, [[libertas|Libertas]], BuildCraftia, New York Nibbas and Elven Fury — which is the record of the May-to-August turnover. No live chronicle card exists for the Emperium: machine-recorded alliance data begins in January 2018, three months after it fell. An earlier draft note in this project's research corpus gave the membership as "UltimateXeons, LE Flowers, TitanZ and Kingdom Foxes"; [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]] appears nowhere in the attested roster, and that note is superseded by the table above.

## Decline and fall

The leadership thinned through the late summer. On 4 September 2017 Nitrogen2Oxygen wrote in the thread: "Such a sad time. Arenos leaves, Josh leaves and now my bot gets hecked" — the alliance's thread-keeper and its Community Leader gone within weeks, alongside a compromised Discord bot that had mass-banned visitors. He promised a replacement thread ("Well I'll fix it in the new thread"); none was ever posted.

[[drew1011|Drew1011]]'s forum profile records the title "Emperator of Emperium of Wynn: 15 October 2017 — 16 October 2017", a reign of a single day; the community guild-timeline image dates "10/17/17 Emperium Falls" to the day after it ended. What happened over those three days is explained by no written source — whether the one-day title was a handover, a coup, or a joke is unrecorded — and the [[coalition|Coalition]] was founded in the same month. The thread's own last two posts are dated 17 October 2017: Paladin A'renos writing "bumity bump bump lets get this back up", and the reply "necro!!! alert alert!!".

## Legacy

The Emperium's people outlasted it. Nitrogen2Oxygen resurfaced as DiamondDeities' representative in [[aesir-pact|the Aesir Pact]] in 2018 alongside [[simplyinfinity|simplyinfinity_]] of Sins of Seedia; IceResistance's [[titans-valor|Titans Valor]] became one of the longest-running guilds in the record; and IceBlueTeam, TheNoLifes and Sins of Seedia all reappear in later alliance rosters. As an institution it left less: no successor claimed the name, and its elaborate constitution of Emperators, Judges and Brother Alliances was not imitated by the war blocs that followed.

## Sources

- Wynncraft forums thread 188024 ("Alliance - The Emperium Of Wynn"), opening post by Paladin A'renos, thread opened 7 May 2017, opening post last revised Aug 2017 — founding date, constitution, 12-guild roster with leaders, honored retired guilds
- Wynncraft forums thread 188024, post #4 (Yuno F Gasai, 7 May 2017) — verbatim quotation of the original May roster and leadership
- Wynncraft forums thread 188024 page 8, posts #149 and #153 (Nitrogen2Oxygen, 4 Sep 2017) and posts #154–155 (17 Oct 2017) — the leadership departures and the thread's final posts
- Drew1011's forum profile title chain — "Emperator of Emperium of Wynn: 15 October 2017 — 16 October 2017"
- Community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ), via Wynncraft forums thread 265297 — "10/17/17 Emperium Falls"
- Wynncraft forums thread 227373 ("The Aesir Pact", opening post as revised 21 Jul 2018) — Nitrogen2Oxygen and simplyinfinity_ in later alliance leadership

articles.title: Empire of Nemract
articles.summary: The Empire of Nemract was a ceremonial community union of The Simple Ones and Mystic Woods, formed on 17 August 2020. Branded 'The Empire of Nemract | ILQ + Aeu' and headed by an empress with court titles, it ran community events through 2021 before going quiet after August 2021; no dissolution was ever recorded.
articles.body:
**The Empire of Nemract** was a community political union of the guilds [[The Simple Ones]] and Mystic Woods, formed on 17 August 2020. It ran community events through 2021 and then quietly disappears from the record.

## History
The union was formed on 17 August 2020 by The Simple Ones [ILQ] and Mystic Woods. From 30 November 2020 it was branded “The Empire of Nemract | ILQ + Aeu”; the identity of the “Aeu” partner guild cannot be safely established today — the tag resolves to a different, later guild, making the identification unreliable — so the recorded membership remains the two founding guilds. Its empress held court titles (“Empress of Nemract, Queen of Aphelion”), and the Empire hosted community events through 2021.

The record goes quiet after 26 August 2021. No dissolution was ever announced, and the end date in the chronicle marks last attestation only. Map-data analysis is consistent with a quiet persistence: The Simple Ones and Mystic Woods exchanged only about thirty territories across six years — they never fought.

## Membership
{{alliance:Empire of Nemract}}

## Legacy
The Empire of Nemract is the era's clearest example of a small ceremonial community alliance operating alongside — and untouched by — the great war blocs of 2020–2021. Both members continued independently; The Simple Ones went on through [[Valhalla]], [[Vanir]] and later [[smtn elf]], while remaining at peace with its old partner throughout.

## Sources
- community Timeline document (17 Aug 2020 formation)
- Wynncraft forums thread 278123 (“ILQ + Aeu” branding, 30 Nov 2020)
- The Simple Ones guild thread, page 11 (26 Aug 2021, last attestation)
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (exchange counts between the member guilds)

articles.title: Goose
articles.summary: Goose was the war coalition that rose against Artemis's map dominance in the winter of 2020-21: first attested as an unnamed group of anti-Artemis guilds in December 2020, carrying the name Goose by 19 January 2021. It took map control and collapsed together with Artemis on 11 May 2021, splitting into Valhalla and Khaos.
articles.body:
**Goose** was the war coalition that rose against [[Artemis]]'s map dominance in the winter of 2020-21, took map control, and collapsed together with its rival on 11 May 2021. Its documentation is unusual: the coalition is first attested before it had a name, and no complete roster was ever published in one place.

## History

### An unnamed coalition
The earliest record is a conflict thread of 18 December 2020, which lists an unnamed group of anti-Artemis guilds - among them [[Avicia]], [[Emorians]], [[Eden]], Ultra Violet, Bovemists, Diablo and The Dark Phoenix - and, notably, [[Paladins United]] and [[Imperial]], the two surviving founders of Artemis itself. Map-data analysis dates the coalition's coordinated war on the Artemis core to that same December, when quiet-territory exchanges jumped to 913 for the month after months of skirmishing. The [[goose-artemis-war|Goose-Artemis war]] would run for the rest of the coalition's life.

### Named by January 2021
The name Goose enters the written record on the morning of 19 January 2021, in two [[the-forum-megalist|megalist]] posts made within half an hour of each other: 99loulou999 of The Dark Phoenix noting that 'TNR (TNI and TNA) are part of Goose', and Lev98bug of Eden asking 'Eden is in Goose if you could add that'. The megalist's maintainer added both and replied, 'Just want to drop in and say that I'm a huge fan of the name.' Who coined it, and when the coalition formally adopted it, was never written down.

Growth continued through the spring. A megalist post of 1 February 2021 by [[urbymine]], a former Chief of Avicia, records that 'BNU(IBT), SHY and TNL are all goose now' - [[ShadowFall]]'s defection from an Artemis leadership seat, alongside IceBlue Team and TheNoLifes. By late March the future [[Khaos]] core ([[Aequitas]], Wheres The Finish, ChinaNumberOne, Eden, joined in April by Fuzzy Spiders) was aboard.

### The fanart roster
Goose is the only alliance in the record whose membership was ever drawn. On 30 March and 6 April 2021 [[drasalia|Drasalia]], a member of ChinaNumberOne, posted two illustration threads personifying twelve member guilds: The Mage Legacy, Aequitas, ChinaNumberOne, Wheres The Finish, TheNoLifes and IceBlue Team in the first, Eden, Guardian of Wynn, Fuzzy Spiders, ShadowFall, The Dark Phoenix and Avicia in the second. The threads are explicitly partial and explicitly unofficial - 'this is just my doodles of what I think the Guilds would look like if they were people', with the second thread noting 'the GOOSE alliance still has more I need to finish'. Members of the drawn guilds replied approvingly, among them Lalatera and FrozenGalaxy of Aequitas, ZrBence of IceBlue Team, DeathLucifer of TheNoLifes and Eden's Lev98bug, which is what makes the diptych usable as evidence of membership rather than merely as art.

On 25 January 2021 Goose and Artemis jointly granted [[Profession Heaven]] neutral status as a public profession-XP guild. Goose took map control from Artemis and held it until 11 May 2021, when both alliances collapsed on the same day - [[the-great-collapse|The Great Collapse]] - splitting into [[Valhalla]] and Khaos.

### What remains unknown
Goose's formation date, internal leadership and full roster were never recorded. Every membership join in the chronicle is a 'by' date, assembled from four dated sources. Two guilds from the December 2020 coalition list - 'Lily Pad' and 'HICH' - cannot be securely matched to any guild in the historical database and are absent from the recorded roster.

## Membership
{{alliance:Goose}}

## Legacy
Goose's split seeded the next era: Valhalla drew on its broad membership while Khaos formed from its core, and the [[valhalla-khaos-war|war between them]] began the day both were founded. The joint protection of Profession Heaven that Goose co-established persisted under successor alliances until 2026.

## Sources
- Wynncraft forums thread 279337 (Sheepn, 18 Dec 2020)
- Wynncraft forums thread 278112 ('the megalist'), posts #71 and #72 of 19 Jan 2021 (99loulou999 and Lev98bug), #76 of 1 Feb 2021 (urbymine) and the posts of 4 Mar 2021, partly via Wayback Machine snapshots
- Wynncraft forums threads 289196 (30 Mar 2021) and 289556 (6 Apr 2021), 'Goose Alliance' fanart by Drasalia of ChinaNumberOne
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (December 2020 war ignition; join dating)

articles.title: Halcyon
articles.summary: Halcyon was a two-guild community alliance founded on 5 June 2016 between ToastedPandas and Holders of LE, announced by Yamipanda with Drew1011 as co-signatory. It was explicitly a mutual-aid and social pact rather than a war bloc, and no source mentions it after June 2016.
articles.body:
**Halcyon**, styled the Halcyon Alliance, was a small community alliance of mid-2016 between the guilds ToastedPandas [TnP] and Holders of LE [HoL]. It belongs to a cluster of non-war alliances that appeared in the [[early-guild-era|early guild era]] alongside [[seraphim|Seraphim]] and [[aurelion|Aurelion]], at a point when a single guild — [[hackforums|HackForums]] — held close to half the territory map and open warring had become unrewarding for most guilds.

## History

Yamipanda, leader of ToastedPandas, posted the announcement thread on 8 June 2016: "On June 5th, 2016, the Halcyon Alliance was born. The Halcyon Alliance was founded upon the vision to create solutions of preparing for success, improving community ideals and player relations." The terms were mutual aid and joint deliberation rather than a war compact: "This is an agreement for whenever help is needed, each member shall aid each other in whatever task it may be. Each guild shall work together to discuss any issues that may arise and compromise to reach agreement."

Its governance mirrored the pattern [[valkyrie|Valkyrie]] used in the same period, splitting internal from external affairs: "Internal affairs are to be handled by individual guild leaders, while matters concerning foreign entities as well as within the whole alliance are to be dealt with by every guild leader and any other representatives." The stated aim was social — "to provide an environment where members can feel comfortable socializing and gaming" — with events and challenges promised.

[[drew1011|Drew1011]], owner of Holders of LE, signed on in the thread the same evening: "Glad to create an alliance with a guild as amazing as TnP. Long live Halcyon. To clarify, it's pronounce Hal-see-on." [[killerfish|Killerfish]] was credited by Yamipanda with "helping with most of the diction" and replied as an insider — "Now, let us all within the alliance see an age of Halcyon" — placing him inside the Halcyon circle a month before he became a founding council member of House of Sentinels, and eighteen months before he founded a [[coalition|Coalition]] guild.

## Membership

Halcyon was founded between exactly two guilds, ToastedPandas and Holders of LE, and no third guild is recorded as joining, though a reader in the thread wished aloud that "this alliance includes increased amounts of guilds". Both members had appeared in the [[ordo-malleus|Ordo Malleus]] roster of February 2016; Holders of LE went on to join [[seraphim|Seraphim]] that August and [[valkyrie|Valkyrie]] that October. The alliance predates the machine-recorded chronicle, which begins in January 2018, so no live membership card exists for it.

## Legacy

No dissolution was recorded and no source mentions Halcyon after June 2016; a reply in the founding thread asking "how long will this last?" went unanswered. Its significance in the record is as evidence of a social layer persisting underneath the territorial situation: the two guilds' leaderships stayed closely tied, and Drew1011 went on to lead [[valkyrie|Valkyrie]] from October 2016 and to found [[the-federation|the Federation]] in 2018.

## Sources

- Wynncraft forums thread 130444 ("Alliance - Halcyon Alliance"), opening post by Yamipanda, 8 Jun 2016 — founding date, the agreement text, governance
- Wynncraft forums thread 130444, post #2 (Killerfish, 8 Jun 2016), post #4 (Drew1011, 8 Jun 2016), post #12 (yuuenchi2, 10 Jun 2016), post #14 (Air_Locke_, 11 Jun 2016)
- Wynncraft forums thread 109350 ("Ultimate Xeons"), post #11 (Drew1011, 20 Feb 2016) — ToastedPandas and Holders of LE in the Ordo Malleus roster
- Wynncraft forums thread 135191 ("House Of Sentinels") — Killerfish on the founding council, July 2016

articles.title: Hestia
articles.summary: Hestia was a community (non-war) alliance spanning the rival war blocs of 2020-2022, first attested in December 2020 around Titans Valor, Empire of Sindria, Lux Nova and Paladins United. It declined through 2022, with Adonis founded as its effective successor; its last attestation is from September 2022.
articles.body:
**Hestia** was a community (non-war) alliance that spanned the rival war blocs of 2020–2022. First attested in December 2020 as a four-guild circle around [[Titans Valor]], it survived the collapses of [[Artemis]], [[Goose]], [[Valhalla]] and [[Vanir]] before fading from the record in 2022, with [[Adonis]] founded as its effective successor.

## History
The earliest record of Hestia is a megalist post of 2 December 2020: “ANO is apart of the alliances Hestia (a community alliance between ANO, ESI, LXA, and PUN) and Artemis (war alliance)”. Its founding was never documented; a 6 June 2021 megalist post described it as “about a year old”, placing its formation around mid-2020, and listed six members: Titans Valor, [[Emorians]], Lux Nova, Empire of Sindria, [[Paladins United]] and [[HackForums]].

Hestia's membership cut across the war-alliance lines of its era: in December 2020 Titans Valor was fighting inside Artemis while Paladins United was attested with the opposing coalition that became Goose — yet both belonged to Hestia. As a community alliance it took no recorded part in the wars themselves.

By May 2022 [[titan-times|Titan Times]], Titans Valor's newsletter, described Hestia as declining but “still around”, and recorded [[Adonis]] being founded as a community successor. Paladins United's recruitment thread continued to list Hestia — alongside [[Valkyrie]], “both community alliances” — until 19 September 2022, the alliance's last attestation anywhere. No dissolution was ever recorded.

## Membership
Joins are “by” dates taken from the two attested rosters; the end date marks last attestation, not a recorded dissolution.

{{alliance:Hestia}}

## Legacy
Hestia is one of the clearest examples of its era's split between war and community alliances: its members fought one another under war banners while remaining social allies in Hestia. Its role passed to Adonis, founded around May 2022 by the leaders of Titans Valor and Empire of Sindria, which outlived every war alliance around it.

## Sources
- Wynncraft forums thread 278112 (“the megalist”), posts of 2 Dec 2020 and 6 Jun 2021, via Wayback Machine snapshots
- Titan Times vol. 1 (8 May 2022)
- Paladins United recruitment thread OP, listings Nov 2021 – 19 Sep 2022, via Wayback Machine

articles.title: Horologium
articles.summary: Horologium was a small Wynncraft war alliance formed on 1 Dec 2019 by DiamondDeities, Titans Valor and The Simple Ones — the last regrouping of the Council of Canyon Kingdoms core. It de facto dissolved on 8 Jan 2020 when Nitrogen2Oxygen disbanded DiamondDeities.
articles.body:
**Horologium** (tag **Horo**) was a small, short-lived Wynncraft war alliance at the turn of 2019–2020 — the last regrouping of the [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]] core before that lineage dissolved entirely.

## History
Horologium was formed on 1 Dec 2019 by [[DiamondDeities]], [[Titans Valor]] and [[The Simple Ones]] — three veterans of [[Terra]] and the Council of Canyon Kingdoms, which had collapsed the week before.

Its end came from outside the war map: on 8 Jan 2020, [[Nitrogen2Oxygen]] disbanded DiamondDeities itself, and Horologium de facto dissolved with it. Most of DiamondDeities' remaining members regrouped as Lux Nova the next day. No formal dissolution of the alliance was ever recorded — with one of its three guilds gone, the record simply ends.

## Membership
{{alliance:Horologium}}

## Legacy
Horologium closed the chain of ever-smaller successor blocs descending from Terra. Within the year its survivors resurfaced in the community alliances of 2020: the chronicle records Titans Valor (with Lux Nova) in [[Hestia]], and The Simple Ones in the [[Empire of Nemract]].

## Sources
- Community Timeline document — founding, and the DiamondDeities disbandment of 8 Jan 2020
- Chronicle alliance records (Hestia; Empire of Nemract) — successor memberships

articles.title: Khaos
articles.summary: Khaos was one of the two war alliances born from The Great Collapse of 11 May 2021, formed largely from the core of Goose. It fought the ex-Valhalla guilds for a year — peaking in January 2022 — and was defunct by 26 June 2022, its guilds absorbed into Cucumber Company.

articles.title: Luna
articles.summary: Luna was a Wynncraft war alliance of 2019, formed on 14 Feb 2019 to counter SOL. It fought Kingdom Foxes across 300+ territories, gained full map control on 17 Jul 2019 after wiping every guild but Avicia, and collapsed in September 2019 after a leadership revolt and the loss of the map to Terra.

articles.title: Niflheim
articles.summary: Niflheim was a community alliance of 2020-2021 whose four attested members — Avicia, IceBlue Team, ShadowFall and TheNoLifes — simultaneously belonged to the era's war blocs. It officially dissolved on 18 December 2021, the same day Vanir collapsed.

articles.title: Ordo Malleus
articles.summary: Ordo Malleus, the Order of the Hammer, was the dominant war alliance of the winter of 2015-16, remembered by a participant as "the greatest alliance to inhabit Wynn". A February 2016 roster names twelve member guilds. The community guild timeline dates its fall to 9 March 2016; a veteran wrote that it "collapsed from the inside because of guilds fighting".

infobox.value: 6 Nov 2015 – 9 Mar 2016 (dates from the community guild timeline)

infobox.label: Peak size
infobox.value: 12 member guilds attested (Feb 2016); recalled in 2016 as seven

articles.body:
**Ordo Malleus** — glossed by a member as "Order of the Hammer"{{cite:thread-143392|post #7, Drew1011, 9 Aug 2016}} — was a Wynncraft war alliance of late 2015 and early 2016, and the earliest bloc in the record described as controlling the territory map. The community guild-timeline image dates its creation to 6 November 2015 and its fall to 9 March 2016.{{cite:thread-265297|post #1, the community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ)}} It has no surviving alliance thread of its own; everything known about it comes from a member guild's recruitment thread and from an argument its veterans had on somebody else's thread five months after it died.

## History

The one contemporaneous roster survives inside the UltimateXeons recruitment thread. On 20 February 2016 the guild's owner motoki1 posted "Update: Joined the Alliance Ordo Malleus!"{{cite:thread-109350|post #7, motoki1, 20 Feb 2016}}, and the opening post — quoted in full by [[drew1011|Drew1011]] the same day — carried an alliance section headed by a single rule, "Don't attack the territories that ally guilds own", above twelve guilds:{{cite:thread-109350|post #11, Drew1011, 20 Feb 2016, quoting the opening post}}

| Guild | Tag |
|---|---|
| Kangronomicon | Fuq |
| Ha Ha United | HHU |
| ToastedPandas | TnP |
| TheNoLifes | TNL |
| Holders of LE | HoL |
| Wynn Theory | WTh |
| Sinners | Snr |
| White Wolves | WWA |
| Necronomicon | Feq |
| [[libertas|Libertas]] | Lir |
| Death Reapers | DxR |
| UltimateXeons | UXs |

Coordination ran through "the Ordo Malleus skype chats", which new UltimateXeons members were asked to join.{{cite:thread-109350|post #11, Drew1011, 20 Feb 2016, quoting the opening post}} Recollections of the alliance's size do not match this roster: arguing in August 2016, Glitchedslayer put it at seven guilds.{{cite:thread-143392|post #13, Glitchedslayer, 9 Aug 2016}} The twelve-tag list is nonetheless the only written count, and it is a snapshot of February 2016 rather than a full membership history.

[[hackforums|HackForums]] was involved and then ejected. "I think you're forgetting that Hax was actually kicked out of Ordo," Drew1011 wrote on 9 August 2016{{cite:thread-143392|post #7, Drew1011, 9 Aug 2016}}; no source records when this happened, or why.

## Membership

The February 2016 roster above is the alliance's only attested membership list; join and departure dates for individual guilds were never published.{{cite:thread-109350|post #11, Drew1011, 20 Feb 2016, quoting the opening post}} Ordo Malleus predates the machine-recorded chronicle, which begins in January 2018, so no live membership card exists for it.{{cite:Chronicle alliance and event records}}

## Legacy

Ordo Malleus became the yardstick veterans reached for whenever a later power looked too large. When Glitchedslayer compared [[hackforums|HackForums]] to it in August 2016 — "both were known as the king of guild territories and stopped everyone from getting and holding land"{{cite:thread-143392|post #10, Glitchedslayer, 9 Aug 2016}} — Drew1011 objected to the comparison itself: "if you're going to try to compare your guild to the greatest alliance to inhabit Wynn, at least spell it right. It's Ordo Malleus. (Order of the Hammer)"{{cite:thread-143392|post #7, Drew1011, 9 Aug 2016}}, adding "I was just trying to defend the memory of the alliance that my friends and I developed."{{cite:thread-143392|post #9, Drew1011, 9 Aug 2016}} That is the closest the record comes to a statement of who built it.

The same exchange preserves the only account of how it ended. Ordo, Glitchedslayer wrote, "collapsed from the inside because of guilds fighting and was much slower because they had the split the land together" — a structural contrast with Hax, a single guild that "gets much more land for itself so it lvls faster and is much harder to die because of inner fighting".{{cite:thread-143392|post #10, Glitchedslayer, 9 Aug 2016}} Drew1011's gloss on the difference was about the era rather than the structure: "people cared a lot more about guilds then and there were a lot more active guilds fighting for territories".{{cite:thread-143392|post #11, Drew1011, 9 Aug 2016}} He also credited Ordo with the first guild ball, the community-event format later alliances copied: "First guild ball was hosted by Ordo. Legio never hosted events."{{cite:thread-188024-p04|post #61, Drew1011, 22 May 2017}} Members still identified with the alliance years later — "Once an Ordo brother always an Ordo brother", written on the 2018 Federation tribute thread.{{cite:thread-237070|post #6, Drew1011, 13 Nov 2018}}

articles.title: War Syndicate
articles.summary: War Syndicate was the Coalition's principal opponent in the winter of 2017, created on 17 July 2017 per the community guild timeline and destroyed that December. It is the least documented major bloc in the record: no roster, no leader and no thread of its own survive, and its sources disagree over whether it was wiped out or merged with its enemy.

infobox.value: WS (abbreviation used in sources; no in-game tag recorded)

infobox.value: War alliance (so described in the 2018 Aesir Pact thread)

articles.body:
**War Syndicate** (WS) was a Wynncraft war bloc of the second half of 2017 and the principal opponent of the [[coalition|Coalition]] in the war that ended the [[early-guild-era|early guild era]]. It is the largest hole in the written record of Wynncraft guild politics: a bloc named repeatedly in later accounts, whose membership, leadership and founding announcement are all missing.

## Classification and the state of the record

War Syndicate has zero forum footprint under its own name. There is no recruitment thread, no roster, no alliance announcement, and no post in which any player is identified as its leader; a Wayback CDX sweep of 19,659 archived Wynncraft thread URLs returned no slug containing "syndicate", and a July 2017 capture of the guild subforum indexes in the founding window shows no such thread. It is treated here as an alliance rather than a guild on the strength of the single written source that classifies it: the Aesir Pact thread of 2018, whose origin story recalls "the peak of the War Syndicate alliance". Everything else about it comes from the community guild-timeline image of April 2020 and from recollections posted in the thread that carried it.

## History

The timeline image dates the bloc's creation to "7/17/17 War Syndicate is created", three months before the Coalition formed. Its one recorded contemporary context comes from the Aesir Pact's origin story, written by [[simplyinfinity|simplyinfinity_]] of Sins of Seedia: "Last year during the peak of the War Syndicate alliance, Fux and SDU became friends with one another. Both were settled in the canyon as well as fought against invaders. The duo was split sadly during the Coalition phase, Fux entering Coalition and SDU warring as a rebel guild against Coalition." That places WS's peak before the Coalition's rise and describes a landscape of canyon-holding guilds resisting invasion, but names no WS member.

The war with the Coalition is dated by the timeline image to December 2017, in a box that gives two dates at once — "War is declared on December 21 2017" and "Coa vs WS 12/17/2017" — without saying which is the declaration.

## The end: two readings

The sources contradict each other on how War Syndicate ended, and the contradiction is recorded here rather than resolved.

The **wipe reading** comes from IceResistance, founder of [[titans-valor|Titans Valor]], writing on 14 April 2020: "wdym Coa never technically 'beat' ws — yes they did. They wiped ws off the map on Christmas day." On this account WS was destroyed as a territorial power on 25 December 2017, and what merged into [[the-federation|the Federation]] the following February was a defeated remnant.

The **merger reading** comes from Lego_DW, ten days earlier in the same thread: "Coa never technically 'beat' WS rather when AA split from coa, Coa and WS merged to wipe a common enemy, this was a creation of fed." On this account WS survived December as a bloc and joined the Coalition remnant on equal terms in February 2018, when [[alliance-alliance|Alliance Alliance]] split away — which is consistent with the chronicle's Federation founding of 16 February 2018.

The timeline image itself gives a third, weaker version: "December 24, 2017 — WS merges with Coa to defeat AA", with "Illustratus is created from the remains of WS" beside it. That date is internally inconsistent with the image's own entries, since the same image dates Alliance Alliance's split from the Coalition to 16 February 2018 — WS cannot have merged on 24 December to defeat an alliance that did not yet exist. The image appears to have compressed the December war and the February merger into one box; the two named recollections above are the better evidence, and they differ only over whether the February merger joined a partner or absorbed a remnant.

## Membership

No membership list for War Syndicate exists in any source. The only guild connected to it by name is Illustratus, which the timeline image says was "created from the remains of WS"; map data places Illustratus' creation on 19 February 2018, three days after the Federation's founding, and the guild's own 2019 revival thread contains no War Syndicate history. War Syndicate is recorded in this wiki as a Discord-era bloc with no written footprint. It predates the machine-recorded chronicle, which begins in January 2018, so no live membership card exists for it.

## Legacy

The bloc that fought the Coalition to the end of 2017 survives in the record only as an abbreviation in other people's stories. Its fate is nonetheless load-bearing: on either reading, the Federation of 2018 — the alliance that went on to hold the entire map for nine months — was built partly out of War Syndicate, so the largest power of the [[federation-era|Federation era]] descends in part from a bloc about which almost nothing is known.

## Sources

- Community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ), via Wynncraft forums thread 265297 — creation 17 Jul 2017, the December war dates, the 24 Dec 2017 merger box, Illustratus
- Wynncraft forums thread 265297, post #16 (Lego_DW, 4 Apr 2020) — the merger reading
- Wynncraft forums thread 265297 page 2, post #34 (IceResistance, 14 Apr 2020) — the Christmas Day wipe
- Wynncraft forums thread 227373 ("The Aesir Pact"), opening post origin story (simplyinfinity_, 2018) — "the peak of the War Syndicate alliance"
- Wynncraft forums thread 251505 ("Illustratus", 25 Jun 2019) — the revival thread, containing no War Syndicate history
- Wayback CDX sweep of forums.wynncraft.com thread slugs (19,659 URLs) and a 21 Jul 2017 capture of the guild subforum index — no War Syndicate thread exists
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis — Illustratus guild creation, 19 Feb 2018

articles.title: Aequitas-Avicia war
articles.summary: The largest war in the entire territory record: Aequitas against Avicia, 3 November to 21 December 2025, with 15,710 quiet-territory exchanges (21,526 total) and a weekly peak of 4,736. It was over by Christmas.

infobox.label: Scale
infobox.value: 15,710 quiet-territory exchanges (21,526 total); weekly peak 4,736 — the largest war in the territory record

articles.body:
The Aequitas-Avicia war of November–December 2025 is the largest war in the entire territory record: 15,710 quiet-territory exchanges — 21,526 including all exchanges — between [[Aequitas]] and [[Avicia]] in seven weeks, with a weekly peak of 4,736.

{{map:2025-11-03|The map when the war began}}

{{war-chart:Aequitas|Avicia|2025-10-19|2026-01-03}}

## Background

Like every war of [[private-diplomacy-era|the private-diplomacy era]], it has no written record: no declaration, no named cause, no published sides beyond the two principals. By late 2025 even the forum's guild-politics venue was gone — the official Discord's #guild-politics channel had been renamed #guild-community that October, and in the words of one guild founder, 'real diplomacy happens in private alliance chats'. Map-data analysis is the sole source.

## Course of the war

The war ran from 3 November to 21 December 2025. Its seven weeks produced more quiet-territory exchanges than any other conflict in the dataset, surpassing the multi-year bloc wars of 2021–22 in raw volume. Which side prevailed is not recorded; the war was over by Christmas.

## Aftermath

No settlement is recorded. Within a year Aequitas was at war again — [[aequitas-sequoia-war|against Sequoia]], the conflict still running as of September 2026.

## Sources

- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (dates, exchange totals, weekly peak; no written record of this war exists)
- Wynncraft forums thread 322643 (Oct 2025) — the #guild-politics rename; IceResistance on private diplomacy
- Chronicle event record: Aequitas-Avicia war

Ongoing as of September 2026.

articles.body:
The Aequitas-Sequoia war is the current war of the Wynncraft territory map: full war between [[Aequitas]] and [[Sequoia]] erupted in the week of 24 August 2026 and is ongoing as of early September 2026.

{{map:2026-08-24|The map when full war erupted}}

{{war-chart:Aequitas|Sequoia|2026-08-09|2026-09-16}}

## Background

The two guilds had clashed before: a one-week fight in August 2025, then renewed skirmishes through spring 2026. Sequoia entered the war as the dominant guild of the era, winner of seven consecutive [[guild-seasons|guild seasons]] from mid-2024 and survivor of [[avicia-sequoia-war|its 2023 war with Avicia]]; Aequitas came off [[aequitas-avicia-war|the largest war in the territory record]] the previous winter, and before that [[the-long-raid|the Long Raid siege]] of 2024.

As with every conflict of [[private-diplomacy-era|the private-diplomacy era]], no cause or declaration was published anywhere; the record is map data and the official API.

## Course of the war

The opening week was among the most violent ever recorded: 7,488 quiet-territory exchanges, with Aequitas driven to zero territories — confirmed at zero by the official API on 2 September 2026.

The war continues, and this account can only cover it through early September 2026. Its later course, and any settlement, are not yet part of the record.

## Aftermath

Not yet written. The war began weeks after Sequoia's mod started capturing Wynncraft's in-game ally broadcasts ([[first-machine-recorded-alliances|June 2026]]), but those records document ally registrations — a relationship used chiefly to permit allied guilds to run guild raids together — and contain nothing about either guild's backing or conduct in this war. As with every conflict of the era, the alliances behind it are undocumented.

## Sources

- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (Aug 2025 clash; spring 2026 skirmishes; week of 24 Aug 2026 eruption, 7,488 exchanges)
- Official Wynncraft API, v3/guild (Aequitas at zero territories, verified 2 Sep 2026)
- Chronicle event record: Aequitas-Sequoia war

articles.title: Avicia-Sequoia war
articles.summary: Avicia's war with the young Sequoia: skirmishes through spring 2023, a main eruption from 30 October to 20 November 2023 peaking at 1,454 quiet-territory exchanges per week, and a second round in January 2024.
articles.body:
The Avicia-Sequoia war was fought between [[Avicia]], a veteran of every major bloc since 2019, and [[Sequoia]], a guild barely a year old — founded 14 October 2022 — whose rise it did nothing to stop.

{{map:2023-10-30|The map when the main eruption began}}

{{war-chart:Avicia|Sequoia|2023-10-15|2024-02-13}}

## Background

The war belongs to [[private-diplomacy-era|the private-diplomacy era]]: no written record of it exists — no declaration, no forum thread, no named cause. Everything known comes from territory_exchanges map-data analysis. Skirmishing between the two guilds is visible through spring 2023, while Avicia was still in [[smtn elf]] and then in the [[Avocado Aquarium]] pact.

## Course of the war

The main eruption ran from 30 October to 20 November 2023, peaking at 1,454 quiet-territory exchanges per week. A second round followed in January 2024. Which side held the advantage is not recorded; the exchange data measures intensity, not victory.

## Aftermath

Sequoia's rise continued regardless of the war: from mid-2024 it won seven consecutive [[guild-seasons|guild seasons]]. Sequoia and [[Aequitas]] would later fight the wars that closed the decade's record, including [[aequitas-sequoia-war|the ongoing war of 2026]]; Avicia went on to fight [[aequitas-avicia-war|the largest war in the territory record]] in late 2025.
