articles.body:
Kingdom Foxes [Fox] carries one of the longest continuous histories in Wynncraft guild warfare, spanning [[early-guild-era|the early guild era]] to the 2020s.

## History

### Kingdom of Foxes and Valkyrie (2015-2017)

Early records name 'Kingdom of Foxes' as co-founder, with [[Imperial]], of [[Valkyrie]] on 2 Jun 2015 — an alliance created 'not for the purpose of war', governed by an Electorate of guild masters, that became the longest-lived in Wynncraft history. Both the guild's own thread and the Valkyrie founding thread were authored by [[lovelusting|LoveLusting]], styled "Queen of the Foxes", which makes her the closest thing the record has to a named founder of the alliance; her Valkyrie thread of September 2015 supplies the founding date, the "not for the purpose of war" clause and the Electorate text. The guild listed in the API today was created on 3 Jul 2016; whether that was a rename or a re-creation of the 2015 guild is not recorded.

Its leadership in that period is preserved mainly through forum titles. [[drew1011|Drew1011]], later the founder of [[the-federation|the Federation]], held "King of the Foxes" from 1 Dec 2016 to 7 Feb 2017 — a stint that matches the guild's 3 Dec 2016 revival in the community timeline — and then "Viceroy of the Foxes" until 7 Feb 2019, the title he was still carrying when he wrote the Federation Tribute. Other era officers named in the corpus include Goden, who rose from recruit to guild leader and was named among the Federation's foremost war leaders, and Robturne.

In October 2017 Kingdom Foxes co-founded the [[Coalition]] with KingdomPhoenixes, Gilded Sparrows and House of Sentinels; the Coalition took the Wynn Province on 23 Nov 2017, wiped War Syndicate on Christmas Day, and gained full map dominance.

### The Federation era (2018)

When five guilds split off in February 2018, starting the [[coalition-civil-war|Coalition Civil War]], Kingdom Foxes went with the Coalition remnant into the Federation and remained until [[the-federation-dies|its collapse on 10 Nov 2018]]. The April 2018 leaderboard capture shows Fox as the map's largest holder, at 82 territories. In the winter interregnum that followed, the community timeline records 'valk owning most of Gavel'.

### The wars of 2019

[[Luna]] fought Kingdom Foxes across 300+ territories from 15 Feb 2019 — Imperial alone attacked Fox 660 times. Peace came stepwise: the Treaty of Rodoroc with [[DiamondDeities]] took effect 2 Mar 2019, and the Treaty of Ternaves (6 Jul 2019) split the dissolved Celestial Tigers' land; Fox joined Luna on 8 Jul 2019. Its departure on 18 Sep 2019 collapsed Luna. Three days earlier it had co-founded the [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]], which it left on 2 Nov 2019.

### Artemis and after (2020-2022)

By March 2020 Kingdom Foxes was an attested member of [[Artemis]], remaining through [[the-great-collapse|the Great Collapse]] of 11 May 2021. It joined [[Cucumber Company]] in spring 2022; map data dates its exit to early July 2022, after which it fought its former bloc. Valkyrie was last attested, with Fox still a member, on 19 Sep 2022.

## Alliances

- [[Valkyrie]] — 2 Jun 2015 – 19 Sep 2022 (co-founder, as 'Kingdom of Foxes'; end is last attestation, not a dissolution)
- [[Coalition]] — Oct 2017 – Feb 2018 (co-founder)

- [[Luna]] — 8 Jul 2019 – 18 Sep 2019

articles.title: Libertas
articles.summary: A major territorial power of 2016: 60 territories on 23 Sep 2016, second only to HackForums. Its owner, its rise up the leaderboard and its alliance memberships are all recoverable from forum threads — but not one of its wars was ever written down.
articles.body:
Libertas [Lir] was one of the largest guilds on the Wynncraft map in 2016. Its scale is known from a Wayback Machine capture of Wynncraft's v1 API guild leaderboard, taken at 22:10 UTC on 23 Sep 2016; almost everything else known about it comes from its own recruitment thread and from other guilds' passing references to it.

## History

### A power recovered from the archive

The capture records Libertas holding 60 territories — nearly a fifth of the ~332-territory map, second only to [[HackForums]]' 146 and ahead of UltimateXeons' 53 — at guild level 59 with 57 members. In the era of [[territory-warfare|territory warfare]] that predates any exchange log, that number marks a first-rank power.

Its rise is datable through its own thread. On 30 Mar 2016 the opening post gave "Rank: 17, Level: 41" and a leadership of three: "Owner: yosteric5. Co-Owner: Amplitude. Head Chief: Master_NinjasHD", with every rank below them empty. On 10 Apr 2016 yosteric5 posted "Libertas is now Ranked #15! we hit level 43 today! I would like to think my active war members for all there hard work." By the thread's last revision on 6 Nov 2016 the header read "Guild Rank: 2, Guild Level: 62", and the guild was recruiting "active players that are level 89+ who are willing to war and attack often". Roughly fifty members are named in that revision, among them Beastovrlrd, who would go on to lead the guild Beasts inside the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]].

### Alliances and the Hax bloc

Libertas belonged to more alliances than any other guild of its size in the period. It appears in the twelve-guild [[ordo-malleus|Ordo Malleus]] roster quoted in February 2016; in the [[seraphim|Seraphim]] community alliance of August 2016; and in the original May 2017 roster of the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]], from which it had been moved to the "Honored Retired Guilds" list by that August — the last dated trace of the guild in any source.

It was also one third of the informal bloc that held the map during [[HackForums]]' dominance. "You do realize Hax has not been a one many army in ages?", a poster wrote in August 2016. "They work with Lir and Bla in order to hold territories" — Bla being Blacklisted, whose own thread listed "We are allied with Libertas (Lir) and Hackforums (Hax)". In March 2017, defending Hax against calls for a territory cap, another asked "are Lir, BLA, UXs somehow exempt?". On the September 2016 capture the three guilds held 228 territories between them.

### What cannot be known

Not one Libertas war is described anywhere. The sampled pages of its own thread are applications and acceptances; the guild is named in other people's threads only as a member of a list or a party to an alliance, never as a belligerent in a recorded action. Exchange-level war data from before January 2018 was never archived anywhere public, so the campaigns that produced its 60 territories are unrecoverable in principle as well as in practice.

Its end is equally unrecorded. There is no disband notice, no final post, no mention after the Emperium's retired-guilds list of August 2017. By the next recovered leaderboard capture (16 Apr 2018) it is gone entirely — all fifteen holders that day were [[the-federation|Federation]] guilds. Whether it dissolved on its own, fell with the Hax bloc, or was absorbed elsewhere is unknown, and the record is silent even on its founding date. The Wynncraft API today lists a guild named Libertas with the same tag, created on 23 Jul 2018 with nine members; whether it has any connection to the 2016 power is unrecorded.

## Alliances

articles.title: Paladins United
articles.summary: Wynncraft guild founded on 2 Jun 2017 by EHTYSCYTHE, with one of the broadest alliance histories on record: the Coalition, Alliance Alliance, the Federation, Terra, co-founder of Artemis, Valkyrie and Hestia member, Goose, Valhalla, Vanir, and smtn elf.
articles.body:
Paladins United [PUN], created on 2 Jun 2017, belonged to more chronicled alliances than nearly any guild in the record. Its own thread states the founding plainly: "It was founded by EHTYSCYTHE on June 2nd, 2017." The thread itself was opened in April 2019 by Carrie, one of the guild's leading figures through the 2019–2020 alliance wars; the research record names Vholtz_ as the guild's owner at that date, while the thread's much-later revisions name Auxiliary_ — the ownership line was evidently rewritten as it changed, and the thread cannot be used to date any one holder.

## History

### The Coalition and the Federation (2017-2018)

By late 2017 Paladins United was in the [[Coalition]]. On 17 Feb 2018 it left with four other guilds to co-found [[Alliance Alliance]], starting the [[coalition-civil-war|Coalition Civil War]]; when the war ended on 20 Mar 2018 the AA guilds were absorbed into [[the-federation|the Federation]], where PUN served two stints (to June, and from August until [[the-federation-dies|the collapse of 10 Nov 2018]]).

### 2019: Terra to Artemis

In the [[the-alliance-wars-of-2019|alliance wars of 2019]] Paladins United fought with [[Terra]] against [[Luna]] (roster largely map-inferred), staying until 30 Oct 2019 — the day it co-founded [[Artemis]] with [[Imperial]] and Caeruleum Order. It is also attested in [[Valkyrie]] from 14 Sep 2019, and in the community alliance [[Hestia]] from around mid-2020; its thread listed both until 19 Sep 2022, the last attestation of each.

### The Valkyrie join-date problem

That 14 Sep 2019 date deserves a caution: it comes from a single document — [[arkada|Arkada]]'s memoir chapter of that day — whose own words work against reading it as a join date. Arkada opens: "The Valkyrie alliance, consisting of Kingdom Foxes, Imperial, Paladins United, and Emorians, have existed for longer than I've played Wynncraft." He wrote as a hostile observer describing an established, long-standing bloc of four guilds. The chronicle, by contrast, records Paladins United and Imperial entering Valkyrie only in September 2019 — after [[Emorians]] had left it in the revolt of late August 2019, so that on the recorded dates the four guilds were never simultaneously members. The likeliest explanation is that the dates mark when the written record first catches these guilds rather than when they joined: Valkyrie's threads had gone quiet after 2017 and no membership list was published between then and the 2020s. The chronicle dates are retained as earliest attestations, with the memoir noted against them.

### Side-switch and the blocs (2020-2023)

By December 2020 PUN had drifted from Artemis to the opposing coalition — it appears in the attested 18 Dec 2020 anti-Artemis list that became [[Goose]] — and stayed until [[the-great-collapse|the Great Collapse]] of 11 May 2021, then joined [[Valhalla]] at its founding and followed it into [[Vanir]]. At the start of Season 8 (autumn 2022) it joined the renamed 'Smtn else' — later [[smtn elf]] — alongside [[The Simple Ones]] and TerraLune, remaining until the alliance's quiet end in mid-2023.

- [[Alliance Alliance]] — 17 Feb 2018 – 20 Mar 2018 (co-founder)
- [[the-federation|Federation]] — 20 Mar – 25 Jun 2018; 23 Aug – 10 Nov 2018
- [[Valkyrie]] — attested 14 Sep 2019 – 19 Sep 2022 (community alliance; a contemporary observer described the membership as long-standing by that date)
- [[Terra]] — 30 Aug 2019 – 30 Oct 2019 (roster largely map-inferred)
- [[Artemis]] — 30 Oct 2019 – ~Dec 2020 (co-founder; departure map-inferred)
- [[Hestia]] — ~mid-2020 – 19 Sep 2022 (last attestation; community alliance)
- [[Goose]] — by 18 Dec 2020 – 11 May 2021
- [[Valhalla]] — 11 May 2021 – 28 Nov 2021
- [[Vanir]] — 28 Nov 2021 – 18 Dec 2021

articles.title: Profession Heaven
articles.summary: A public profession-XP guild founded by Crokee in January 2021 and granted neutral status that same month under the joint protection of Goose and Artemis. Its neutrality outlived both protectors and every successor alliance, ending only in May 2026 when KongoBoys began a sustained campaign against it.
articles.body:
Profession Heaven [PROF] occupies a unique position in the warring record: a guild whose territory was held by treaty rather than by force.

## History

### Neutrality (2021)

Profession Heaven was created on 20 Jan 2021 by [[crokee|Crokee]], who ran it as chief and wrote and maintained its forum thread, as a public profession-XP guild. Five days later, on 25 Jan 2021, it was granted neutral status - protected by both [[Goose]] and [[Artemis]], the two warring blocs of the day - and given territory in the Silent Expanse. Its first territory exchange is dated that same day. Who brokered the arrangement is not recorded anywhere in the public sources; the pact's date survives only through the community Timeline document.

Crokee codified the guild's posture as internal law in the thread of 9 Feb 2021, whose rules include 'Keep the guild as neutral as possible towards all other guilds. No bias towards any guild.' The guild's stated goal was 'to be able to provide territory GXP boost to Dernic professions to any player who needs it', with open temporary membership for any player who wanted the boost. The arrangement survived [[the-great-collapse|the Great Collapse]] of May 2021 and the successor blocs that followed.

### Inside the super-alliances (2022-2023)

Profession Heaven appears in [[Cucumber Company]]'s 14-guild roster posted to [[the-forum-megalist|the forum megalist]] on 26 Jun 2022 - the last public alliance roster ever - and carried through the renames into [[smtn elf]], remaining until that alliance's quiet dissolution in mid-2023. Through the wars of [[private-diplomacy-era|the private-diplomacy era]] that followed, its land went largely unmolested.

### The fall of neutrality (2026)

On 25 May 2026 KongoBoys - a former Cucumber Company and smtn elf ally - began [[fall-of-profession-heaven-s-neutrality|a sustained campaign against Profession Heaven]], running as high as 1,700 quiet-territory exchanges a week and ending five years of neutrality. The campaign was ongoing as of the last data in the record.

## Alliances

- [[Cucumber Company]] - spring 2022 - Sep 2022
- [[smtn elf]] - Sep 2022 - Jun 2023

Its 2021 neutrality was a treaty under Goose and Artemis protection, not an alliance membership.

articles.title: Sequoia
articles.summary: Wynncraft guild founded on 14 Oct 2022 that rose to win seven consecutive guild seasons from mid-2024. Its open-source mod produced the first machine-captured records of the game's in-game ally system in June 2026. Fought Avicia in 2023-24 and has been at war with Aequitas since August 2026.
articles.body:
Sequoia [SEQ] is a Wynncraft guild created on 14 Oct 2022, owned by [[gazthecat|GaztheCat]]. It rose during [[private-diplomacy-era|the private-diplomacy era]], when alliance politics had left the public forums, so much of its history is known only from map data and from its own software.

## History

### Rise (2022-2024)

Within its first year Sequoia drew the attention of an established power: [[Avicia]] skirmished with it through spring 2023, and [[avicia-sequoia-war|the main eruption came on 30 Oct - 20 Nov 2023]], peaking at 1,454 quiet-territory exchanges per week, with a second round in January 2024. The war did not slow the guild — from mid-2024 Sequoia won seven consecutive guild seasons.

### The machine record (2026)

Wynncraft's in-game ally system had existed since version 1.20 (20 Jan 2021), but Sequoia's open-source mod made the first machine captures of its events in June 2026: Sequoia formed an alliance with Silk Road; Anime Lovers revoked theirs with Sequoia; GaztheCat revoked with Chiefs Of Corkus; and Radiant Roses formed one — [[first-machine-recorded-alliances|the first machine-recorded alliances]]. These are in-game ally registrations, a relationship used chiefly to permit allied guilds to run guild raids together, and not evidence of political alliance. From 30 Jul 2026 the mod began auto-snapshotting the in-game Diplomacy menu to Sequoia's private backend, a growing machine-readable record of those registrations.

### The Aequitas war (2026)

After a one-week clash in August 2025 and spring 2026 skirmishes, [[aequitas-sequoia-war|full war with Aequitas]] erupted in the week of 24 Aug 2026 — 7,488 quiet-territory exchanges in its first week, with Aequitas driven to zero territories. The war is ongoing.

## Alliances

Sequoia appears in none of the twenty-two chronicled alliances of 2015-2024; by its era, alliance rosters had moved to private Discords, and no political alliance of Sequoia's is recorded anywhere. What its own mod captured are in-game ally registrations — a game-mechanical relationship used chiefly to permit allied guilds to run guild raids together, which is not evidence of a political alliance and says nothing about whether the guilds were aligned:

- Silk Road — ally registered, June 2026
- Chiefs Of Corkus — ally registration revoked by GaztheCat, June 2026 (registration date unrecorded)
- Anime Lovers — ally registration revoked by Anime Lovers, June 2026 (registration date unrecorded)

## Sources

- Wynncraft API v3/guild (creation date, retrieved 2 Sep 2026)
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (Avicia war 2023-24; Aequitas war 2026)
- Sequoia-mod repository, commit 69fb472 (12 Jun 2026, chat-parsing fixtures) and commit 8b27368 / Modrinth 1.8.0 changelog (30 Jul 2026)
- Chronicle event records (Avicia-Sequoia war, Aequitas-Sequoia war, first machine-recorded alliances)

ShadowFall [Shy] was created on 21 Aug 2017, but enters the written warring record in 2020.

## History

### An Artemis leader (2020)

In March 2020 ShadowFall's GoulartJJ posted on the forums as a leader of [[Artemis]] — the map-holding alliance of the day — placing the guild not just in the bloc but at its top. It joined the community alliance [[Niflheim]] on 27 Dec 2020.

articles.title: Sins of Seedia
articles.summary: Sins of Seedia (SDU) is a Wynncraft guild founded in May 2017 — a Federation-era stalwart and Aesir Pact co-founder in 2018, later a member of Artemis, Cucumber Company and smtn elf, and still active as of 2026.
articles.body:
Sins of Seedia (SDU) was founded on 6 May 2017, per the official guild API. It spans nearly the whole recorded history of alliance warfare, from the Federation era to the present.

## History

### Federation era

Sins of Seedia enters the record as a founding-era member of [[The Federation]] in February 2018. On 25 Mar 2018 it co-founded the [[Aesir Pact]] with [[Fantasy]] and IceBlue Team — a pact of sister guilds "especially dedicated to Gavel, and the birth place of Aesir, the canyon" — with its leader simplyinfinity_ named among the pact's creators. The Aesir guilds were the Federation's last defenders: as [[the-federation-dies|the alliance fell]] on 10–11 Nov 2018, they quit only after fourteen hours of constant warring, and Aesir died with the Federation.

### Later blocs

The alliance record then goes quiet for over two years. Sins of Seedia reappears in [[Artemis]] from March 2021, staying until [[the-great-collapse|the alliance collapsed]] on 11 May 2021. In the 2022 realignment it joined [[Cucumber Company]]; the alliance's full fourteen-guild roster — the last public alliance roster ever posted — was submitted to the forum megalist on 26 Jun 2022 by SDU's own TherapueticLiz. The guild carried through the rename into [[smtn-elf|smtn elf]] and stayed until the alliance's quiet end in June 2023.

As of September 2026 the guild remains active — level 90, around 75 members, led by TherapueticLiz — holding no territories.

## Alliances

- [[The Federation]] — February – November 2018
- [[Aesir Pact]] — co-founder, March – November 2018
- [[Artemis]] — March – May 2021
- [[Cucumber Company]] — spring – autumn 2022
- [[smtn-elf|smtn elf]] — September 2022 – June 2023

articles.title: The Aquarium
articles.summary: Wynncraft guild founded in March 2020, active in territory warfare from its first days. A founding member of Valhalla and Vanir, a member of Cucumber Company and smtn elf, half of the Avocado Aquarium pact, and a principal in the 2024-25 Idiot Co-Aquarium war, the biggest war since 2021.
articles.body:
The Aquarium [TAq] is a Wynncraft guild created on 22 Mar 2020, in the middle of the [[goose-artemis-war|Goose-Artemis war]]; map data records its first territory exchange the following day. Its earliest alignment was never written down — map analysis places its first fighting on the anti-[[Artemis]] side of that war, but no written roster attests any alliance membership before 2021.

## History

### The Valhalla years (2021)

On 11 May 2021, the day of [[the-great-collapse|the Great Collapse]], The Aquarium was one of the thirteen guilds that founded [[Valhalla]], which took map control within days. When Valhalla reorganized as [[Vanir]] on 28 Nov 2021, The Aquarium was among the ten founding guilds; Vanir collapsed twenty days later. Through the following winter it fought in the [[valhalla-khaos-war|war against Khaos]], which peaked in January 2022 and faded by mid-July — the run-up to [[the-realignment-era|the realignment]].

### Cucumber Company to the Avocado split (2022-2024)

For guild Season 5 (spring 2022) The Aquarium joined [[Cucumber Company]], appearing in the 14-guild roster posted to the [[the-forum-megalist|forum megalist]] on 26 Jun 2022 — the last public alliance roster ever — and carried through the alliance's renames into [[smtn elf]]. In June 2023 it and [[Avicia]] walked out, rejecting pressure to shrink their claims, and as the two-guild [[Avocado Aquarium]] pact the pair waged [[the-avocado-split|a sniping and claim-taking campaign]] against their former allies into early 2024, running shared infrastructure including the joint subguild Avoquarium [HQs] and the subguild [[ShadowFall]].

### The Idiot Co war (2024-2025)

From 29 Apr 2024 The Aquarium fought [[Idiot Co]] in [[idiot-co-aquarium-war|the biggest war since 2021]] — a weekly peak of 5,045 quiet-territory exchanges — through mid-July 2024, with a second round from November 2024 into January 2025, spanning the Rekindled World map rework of 10 Aug 2024.

articles.title: The Simple Ones
articles.summary: Wynncraft guild founded in February 2019 whose defection from Luna to Terra decided the war for the map in September 2019. Later a Horologium co-founder, half of the Empire of Nemract political union, a Valhalla and Vanir guild, and a smtn elf member.
articles.body:
The Simple Ones [ILQ] was created on 5 Feb 2019, nine days before [[Luna]] formed — and the chronicle carries it as an early Luna member (its join is approximated to the alliance's founding; only its departure is documented).

## History

### The defection that decided a war (2019)

The Simple Ones signed the Treaty of Ternaves on 6 Jul 2019 with [[Kingdom Foxes]] and ThisIsMurica, splitting the territory of the dissolved Celestial Tigers. Two months later came its decisive act in [[the-alliance-wars-of-2019|the alliance wars of 2019]]: on 8 Sep 2019, mid-war, it defected from Luna to [[Terra]] — and Terra took control of the map the same day. It then co-founded the [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]] on 15 Sep 2019, staying to its 23 Nov collapse, and co-founded [[Horologium]] on 1 Dec 2019, which died with [[DiamondDeities]]' disbandment on 8 Jan 2020.

### The Empire of Nemract (2020-2021)

On 17 Aug 2020 The Simple Ones formed the [[Empire of Nemract]], a political union with Mystic Woods later branded 'The Empire of Nemract | ILQ + Aeu', whose empress held court titles ('Empress of Nemract, Queen of Aphelion'). The record goes quiet after August 2021; map data shows the two guilds never fought, so the union may have persisted quietly. On 21 May 2021 ILQ signed the Treaty of Damask, under which Nefarious Ravens declared independence.

### The blocs (2021-2023)

The Simple Ones was a founding member of [[Valhalla]] on 11 May 2021 and followed it into [[Vanir]]. At the start of Season 8 (autumn 2022) it joined the renamed 'Smtn else' — later [[smtn elf]] — remaining until the alliance's quiet end in mid-2023.

articles.body:
Titans Valor [ANO], created on 2 Jul 2017, appears in more chronicled alliances than almost any other guild - and documented much of that history itself through its newsletter, the [[titan-times|Titan Times]].

## History

### Federation and the wars of 2019

Titans Valor cycled through [[the-federation|the Federation]] three times in 2018 (February-May, June-July, and September to the collapse). In 2019 it fought with [[Terra]] against [[Luna]] (roster largely map-inferred), co-founded the [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]] on 15 Sep 2019, left on 21 Nov - two days before the alliance collapsed - and co-founded [[Horologium]] on 1 Dec 2019 with [[DiamondDeities]] and [[The Simple Ones]], which died with DiamondDeities' disbandment on 8 Jan 2020.

### Hestia, Artemis, and the blocs of 2020-2021

From around mid-2020 Titans Valor belonged to the community alliance [[Hestia]]. By 2 Dec 2020 it was attested in [[Artemis]] - the attestation came from its own member [[paladinsorcerer|Pally]], who wrote on [[the-forum-megalist|the megalist]] that 'ANO is apart of the alliances Hestia (a community alliance between ANO, ESI, LXA, and PUN) and Artemis (war alliance) made up of all the current massive land holding guilds on the map'. The guild stayed through [[the-great-collapse|the Great Collapse]] of 11 May 2021 into [[Valhalla]] and [[Vanir]], and fought the ex-Valhalla side of [[valhalla-khaos-war|the Khaos war]] into 2022.

### The realignment and Adonis (2022-2024)

Titans Valor joined [[Cucumber Company]] for Season 5, which ran from 3 Mar to 2 May 2022 - its newsletter's first volume (8 May 2022) records 'our first season being a part of the new Cucumber Company war alliance' - and carried into [[smtn elf]] until that alliance's quiet death in mid-2023. Around May 2022 its leaders and Empire of Sindria's founded [[Adonis]] as Hestia declined, 'a space for those of us who are still active to hang together'; Adonis was still active in March 2024.

### Ownership

[[iceresistance|IceResistance]] founded the guild and opened its recruitment thread on 15 Oct 2017, and was still speaking for it politically in December 2020. Titan Times vol. 6 (12 Oct 2022) reports him on hiatus, and vol. 9 (25 Mar 2023) describes him as the guild's founder and previous owner - so ownership changed hands at some point between those two issues. Vols. 1-13 never name the successor.

Vols. 14-21, archived later, close part of the gap. In vol. 20 (23 Nov 2025) the guild's leader, Calluum - a Sage Council member back in vol. 1 - was interviewed by Lamplesspost and asked how he became leader: 'No one else wanted it when pally was stepping down, so I realised I'd need to step up and take on the mantle.' This is the only public account of the succession, and it is a single sentence. It establishes that Pally - on the strength of the name, ANO's [[paladinsorcerer|PaladinSorcerer]], though the interview gives no fuller form - led the guild before Calluum, and that Calluum led it by November 2025. It does not say whether Pally took over directly from IceResistance, and it dates neither handover. The interval between October 2022 and Pally's departure remains unattributed.

IceResistance remained a public voice for the guild long after leaving the ownership: his October 2025 forum remark that real diplomacy 'happens in private alliance chats' names the defining fact of [[private-diplomacy-era|the private-diplomacy era]].

### After the alliance record (2024-2026)

Titan Times ran to vol. 21 on 18 May 2026, but from vol. 14 onward it names no alliance at all, reporting only guild-internal affairs: the guild reached level 105 in mid-2024, placed fifth on the Season 21 leaderboard and sixth in Season 22, and continued its internal Ocean Trials war rankings through Season 29.

- [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]] - 15 Sep 2019 - 21 Nov 2019 (co-founder)

articles.title: 99loulou999
articles.summary: Member of The Dark Phoenix [TNI] who wrote the earliest surviving use of the alliance name Goose, on 19 January 2021, and gave the fullest first-hand account of the Rays desert war a month later.

infobox.label: Known for
infobox.value: First written use of the name [[goose|Goose]] (19 Jan 2021)

articles.body:
On 19 January 2021, 99loulou999 asked [[the-forum-megalist|the megalist]] for an update: "TNR (TNI and TNA) are part of Goose, idk if we already have an editor tho". It is the earliest recorded use of the name [[goose|Goose]] anywhere in the written record — the anti-[[artemis|Artemis]] coalition had been described a month earlier as "a currently unnamed group". Lev98bug of Eden added his guild the same morning, and Sg_Voltage answered both: "Just want to drop in and say that I'm a huge fan of the name."

A month later, on 20 February 2021, he wrote the longest surviving account of the multi-guild raid on Rays' desert holdings, in the thread "The Issue With 1.20 Guild Wars". Against the claim that attack prices were broken, he replied that the poster was "overshadowing the fact that every guild in artemis except probably 4 were warring the whole desert/savanah/rymek area currently held by Rays, so its normal that after 5h of constant warring the 'pity price'... rose up". On the defenders' position: "Rays HQ kept getting taken because they couldn't war againts 10+ guilds". On his own guild's logistics: "Speaking from experience in TNI during the Rays raid: our smallest attack timer without counting the 10 minutes cooldown was 8 minutes" — the best in the alliance, since no other headquarters sat closer to the desert. He classed "TNI and CXZ" as "two guilds I would consider medium sized".

## Sources

- Wynncraft forums thread 278112 ("the megalist"), post #71 of 19 Jan 2021 (p4)
- Wynncraft forums thread 286375 ("The Issue With 1.20 Guild Wars", _Eragon_, 20 Feb 2021), posts #2 and #7

articles.title: Arkada
articles.summary: Titans Valor's Aedile and "chief negotiator", and author of a near-contemporaneous memoir of the Luna-Terra war of 2019.

infobox.label: Known for
infobox.value: The "Inside Myself" memoir of the [[luna-terra-war|Luna-Terra war]] (Sep 2019)

articles.body:
Arkada (forum name Leonhart_Arkada) was a member of [[titans-valor|Titans Valor]] [ANO], the guild founded by [[IceResistance]], and carried the forum title Aedile - "chief negotiator".

In July 2019 he authored "An Argument Against The Current Monopoly On Territory" (thread 252647, 20 July 2019), describing [[Luna]] as "the four most powerful guilds on Wynn" and comparing its dominance to the [[the-federation|Federation]]'s; [[drew1011|Drew1011]] replied with the era's standard defense of mega-alliance cycles.

Around 14 September 2019, with the [[luna-terra-war|Luna-Terra war]] still in motion, he published "Inside Myself - Recent Wynncraft Guild History" on Wattpad under the alias A_Challenger_Arrives - a near-contemporaneous memoir, written as events unfolded rather than years later. It records that [[Valkyrie]] was "now calling themselves Luna"; that [[Terra]] formed from multiple small alliances merging "nearly 15 guilds", including The Ascendancy in which Titans Valor fought; that Terra's weekend raid conquered all Luna territories except [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]]' within six hours; and that Luna's organized counter-raid of 14 September failed. As a participant's memoir it is partisan by nature, and the chronicle cites it as recollection rather than neutral record - but its closeness to the events makes it the era's most valuable single narrative source.

## Sources

- Wynncraft forums thread 252647 (Leonhart_Arkada, 20 Jul 2019); Aedile title from the same thread
- "Inside Myself - Recent Wynncraft Guild History" (Wattpad, A_Challenger_Arrives, ~14 Sep 2019): https://www.wattpad.com/784189853-inside-myself-recent-wynncraft-guild-history

articles.title: AurumKitsune
articles.summary: "Queen of Phoenixes" who founded KingdomPhoenixes in September 2017, a month before it joined the Coalition's founding circle, and later established the Federation's two-thirds-majority voting rule.
articles.body:
AurumKitsune founded the guild KingdomPhoenixes [PHX], announcing it on the forums on 24 September 2017 (thread 204381) under the title "Queen of Phoenixes". The guild was "officially established" on 23 September 2017 - "We arose from the ashes of a dead guild, and re-birthed the spark that was missing!" - with Whimsy and Thundderr as its first chiefs. One month later KingdomPhoenixes stood among the founder guilds of the [[Coalition]] (created October 2017), making AurumKitsune's brand-new guild part of the founding circle alongside [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]], Gilded Sparrows and House of Sentinels.

Her larger legacy came in the [[the-federation|Federation]] (2018). [[drew1011|Drew1011]]'s "Federation Tribute" (thread 237070, 13 November 2018) credits AurumKitsune with building the alliance's Discord infrastructure and with establishing its two-thirds-majority voting rule - the governance mechanism by which the alliance that held the whole map made its decisions. Her own reply in the tribute thread added: "I still can not believe that I made the logo for fed a meme and it was never changed. Deus Vult!" (14 November 2018).

## Sources

articles.title: Chownick
articles.summary: Founder of TheNoLifes on 27 December 2014, one of the oldest guilds on Wynncraft, and its owner when the guild joined the Emperium of Wynn in 2017.

infobox.label: Alliances
infobox.value: [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]] (TNL owner on the 2017 roster)

articles.body:
Chownick founded TheNoLifes [TNL] on 27 December 2014, within months of the guild system's introduction. The guild's own thread records it as "founded on 27th December 2014 by Chownick, placing it as one of the oldest guilds in existence since the introduction of the guild system in Wynn."

He was still the guild's owner in 2017, when TheNoLifes joined the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]]: the alliance thread's roster lists "The No Lifes (TNL) - Owner: chownick" among its twelve member guilds, beside [[titans-valor|Titans Valor]] under [[iceresistance|IceResistance]] and [[sins-of-seedia|Sins of Seedia]] under simplyinfinity_.

He also belonged to the Ordo Malleus circle of the mid-2010s. Replying to the Federation Tribute on 13 November 2018 with "ordo buddies", he drew from [[drew1011|Drew1011]] the answer "Once an Ordo brother always an Ordo brother."

TheNoLifes long outlasted his tenure — recorded switching to [[goose|Goose]] in February 2021 and inside [[niflheim|Niflheim]] that July — but no source records when or how Chownick left its leadership.

articles.title: Crokee
articles.summary: Founder of Profession Heaven, the profession-XP guild granted protected neutrality by both Goose and Artemis in January 2021, and the author of the rules that made that neutrality internal law.
articles.body:
Crokee founded [[profession-heaven|Profession Heaven]] [PROF], created on 20 January 2021 to hold the south-eastern Dernic profession territories and share their guild-XP boosts with any player who wanted them. Five days after the guild's creation it was granted protected neutrality by both [[goose|Goose]] and [[artemis|Artemis]], then at war; no surviving public source names the brokers of that arrangement.

Crokee opened the guild's forum thread (285237) on 9 February 2021 and used it to write neutrality into the guild's own law. War members were required to "Keep the guild as neutral as possible towards all other guilds. No bias towards any guild", to fight only defensively — "You may NOT war to take any territory outside of SE, except for FFAs" — and to "Be able to communicate with other guilds while keeping an unbiased stance towards them". Permanent members had to "agree to not have ANY affiliation with any prior major guild that held several territories over long periods of time. Meaning to resolve any potential conflicts of interest relating to other guilds", and were barred from cycling out into major guilds.

The open-door mechanics were unusual: anyone could join as a temporary member with "no requirements... except to join the guild Discord", with no obligation to do anything guild-related, and the guild kept room for "a full server + 41 permanent members" of profession grinders.

## Sources

- Wynncraft forums thread 285237 (Profession Heaven guild thread, opened by Crokee 9 Feb 2021): membership tiers and the neutrality rules
- Chronicle record of the 25 Jan 2021 Goose–Artemis protection pact (date only; brokers unrecorded)

articles.title: Drasalia
articles.summary: Member of ChinaNumberOne who drew the Goose alliance as twelve personified characters across two forum art threads in spring 2021 — the only visual record of an alliance roster in the guild community’s history.

infobox.label: Known for
infobox.value: The [[goose|Goose]] alliance fanart, 30 Mar and 6 Apr 2021

articles.body:
Drasalia, a member of ChinaNumberOne [CNM], produced the only visual record of an alliance roster in the guild community's history: two forum art threads drawing the guilds of [[goose|Goose]] as people. The first, on 30 March 2021, covered ChinaNumberOne, [[aequitas|Aequitas]], Where's The Finish, The Mage Legacy, TheNoLifes and IceBlue Team; the second, on 6 April 2021, covered Eden, Guardian of Wynn, Fuzzy Spiders, [[shadowfall|ShadowFall]], The Dark Phoenix and [[avicia|Avicia]] — twelve guilds in all.

The captions were careful about their own limits: "Please understand that this is just my doodles of what I think the Guilds would look like if they were people. It's not representative of them by any means", and "There's a lot more and I only did the ones that I was more familiar with so I'm sorry if your guild is not on here." They also carry incidental political detail — TheNoLifes described as "the ones that know more about guild politics", Eden as "the big bois who own a whole lotta territory", and Avicia's claims as "currently located in the Sky Islands".

The threads doubled as attestation. Replies from Lalatera (Aequitas), ZrBence (IceBlue Team), DeathLucifer (TheNoLifes) and FrozenGalaxy (Aequitas) confirmed their guilds' membership of Goose from inside those guilds, in a period when [[the-forum-megalist|the megalist]]'s alliance column was the only other written source.

articles.title: Drew1011
articles.summary: Founder and unofficial leader of the Federation, leader of the Valkyrie alliance (2016-2018), one-day Emperator of the Emperium of Wynn, and the guild community's principal historian.

infobox.label: Guild(s)
infobox.value: Holders of LE (owner, 16 Dec 2015 - 31 Jan 2018); [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]] (King, then Viceroy)

infobox.label: Other titles
infobox.value: Emperator of the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]], 15-16 Oct 2017

articles.body:
Drew1011 is the player recorded as founder and unofficial leader of the [[the-federation|Federation]], the dominant alliance of the [[federation-era|Federation era]], which held the entire territory map for 8 months and 25 days in 2018.

His forum profile (member 2157) preserves an exact title chain across the era's institutions. He owned the guild Holders of LE from 16 December 2015 to 31 January 2018, and co-founded the Halcyon Alliance - a mutual-aid pact between Holders of LE and Yamipanda's ToastedPandas - in June 2016 (thread 130444). On 15 October 2016 he authored the third relaunch of the [[Valkyrie]] alliance (thread 159734, with [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]], Holders of LE and Ha Ha United as members) and held "Leader of Valkyrie Alliance" from that day until 10 March 2018. In Kingdom Foxes he was "King of the Foxes" from 1 December 2016 to 7 February 2017 - matching the guild's 3 December 2016 revival in the community timeline - then "Viceroy of the Foxes" until 7 February 2019. Strangest of all, he was Emperator of the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]] for a single day, 15-16 October 2017 - the day before the alliance fell. No written source explains the one-day reign.

When the Federation formed in February 2018 from the [[Coalition]]'s fracture and merger with [[war-syndicate|War Syndicate]], the record consistently names Drew1011 its founder and leader (his profile: "Founder of the Federation", 16 Feb - 10 Nov 2018) - though not without a rival claim: [[slayne|Slayne]] asserted a causal founder's role via [[alliance-alliance|Alliance Alliance]]'s creation (thread 237070 p3 #45, 14 November 2018).

Three days after [[the-federation-dies|the Federation's collapse]] on 10 November 2018, he posted the "Federation Tribute" (thread 237070, 13 November 2018) - a full roster of its 37 member guilds and the alliance's epitaph: "What killed Federation was... internal affairs." He also maintained on Discord "a massive ongoing written history of the guild community from May 2015 onwards" (his reply in thread 251543, June 2019) - the era's largest known unpublished chronicle.

- Wynncraft forums thread 159734 ("Valkyrie Alliance" relaunch by Drew1011, 15 Oct 2016)

- Wynncraft forums thread 251543 ("The Federation (?)", Drew1011's reply of 27 Jun 2019: the Discord history project)

articles.title: FrozenGalaxy
articles.summary: Owner of Aequitas — "Justice Frozenman" in the guild’s courtroom-styled hierarchy — who opened its recruitment thread in January 2021 and led it into Goose.

infobox.label: Known for
infobox.value: Leading Aequitas from its Jan 2021 relaunch into [[goose|Goose]]

articles.body:
FrozenGalaxy is recorded as the owner of [[aequitas|Aequitas]] [Aeq]. He opened the guild's recruitment thread (280525) on 3 January 2021 and bumped it through that winter; its rank system is styled on a courtroom, with the two "Justices" of a Supreme Court at the top — "Justice Frozenman [OWNER]" and "Justice Lalatera [CHIEF]" — above Judges, Attorneys, Advocates, Jury and Witnesses. The guild's artwork is credited to Lalatera. The thread's own text gives Aequitas's founding as 24 November 2019, so the January 2021 thread marks a relaunch of public recruiting rather than the guild's creation.

On 17 January 2021 he added the guild to [[the-forum-megalist|the megalist]] — "Add Aequitas to the list tyvm <3 / Lvl. 48 Community and War" — its first appearance in the public register. By the end of March, Aequitas was inside [[goose|Goose]]: FrozenGalaxy was among the members who replied to [[drasalia|Drasalia]]'s Goose fanart of 30 March 2021 confirming the guild's place in the alliance, alongside Lalatera. Aequitas went on into [[khaos|Khaos]] and then [[cucumber-company|Cucumber Company]].

articles.title: GaztheCat
articles.summary: Owner of the guild Sequoia, named in a June 2026 in-game ally broadcast captured by Sequoia's client mod — the cancellation of an ally registration, a game-mechanical relationship used chiefly to permit joint guild raids.

infobox.label: Attested
infobox.value: Jun 2026 in-game ally broadcast (Sequoia mod capture)

articles.body:
GaztheCat is the owner of [[Sequoia]], the guild founded on 14 October 2022 that rose to win seven consecutive [[guild-seasons|guild seasons]] from mid-2024 and fought the [[avicia-sequoia-war|Avicia–Sequoia war]] (2023–24) and the ongoing [[aequitas-sequoia-war|Aequitas–Sequoia war]] (2026).

GaztheCat appears by name in the game's own record: among [[first-machine-recorded-alliances|the first machine-recorded alliance events]] captured by Sequoia's open-source mod in June 2026 is the in-game broadcast 'GaztheCat revoked the alliance with Chiefs Of Corkus'. The event is the cancellation of an in-game ally registration — a game-mechanical relationship used chiefly to permit allied guilds to run guild raids together — and is not evidence of a political falling-out between the two guilds. The mod's research-notes gloss identifies the account as Sequoia's owner. No other public guild-history facts about the player are recorded in the chronicle's sources.

articles.title: GoulartJJ
articles.summary: ShadowFall’s leader in 2020 and, by his own account, "one of Artemis leaders" — the only dated first-person claim to an Artemis leadership seat anywhere in the record.

infobox.label: Known for
infobox.value: The only attested [[artemis|Artemis]] leadership seat (9 Mar 2020)

articles.body:
On 9 March 2020, in VeeeKoooN's thread "The Artemis Alliance And Why It's Problematic To Me", GoulartJJ replied: "Hello, as the Shadow Fall leader and one of Artemis leaders I'd like to say that small guilds can grow very easily, alliance or not". It is the only dated, first-person claim to an [[artemis|Artemis]] leadership seat in the entire corpus, and the clearest evidence of [[shadowfall|ShadowFall]]'s standing in the alliance.

The rest of the post is the fullest statement of how Artemis explained itself. On growth: ShadowFall "grew with FFA's, we were level 20ish by August of last year, we tried joining [[luna|Luna]] when we were leveling but got denied, that didn't stop us". On the map: "If you're not in a map controlling alliance, nothing stops you from attacking any territories in the map, some may reclaim it instantly, others would rather use a diplomatic approach". On the distribution of land: "Guilds who are with big claims are the guilds who have contributed the most to the alliance." On entry: "Guilds may also apply to Artemis by contacting one of the guild leaders, and possibly be accepted."

Within a year ShadowFall had changed sides — [[urbymine]] reported on 1 February 2021 that "BNU(IBT), SHY and TNL are all goose now". GoulartJJ's forum badge reads [[imperial|Imperial]] at capture time, indicating later movement between guilds; the 2020 post text remains the authority for his ShadowFall role.

## Sources

- Wynncraft forums thread 263975 ("The Artemis Alliance And Why It's Problematic To Me", VeeeKoooN, 9 Mar 2020), post #36 (p2)
- Wynncraft forums thread 278112 ("the megalist"), post #76 of 1 Feb 2021 (p4)

articles.title: HungHung
articles.summary: Avicia’s poster of record on the forum megalist in 2021, whose request of 7 July 2021 is the only surviving roster of the Niflheim community alliance.
articles.body:
HungHung filed [[avicia|Avicia]]'s updates to [[the-forum-megalist|the megalist]] during 2021, including routine guild-level corrections in May of that year. On 7 July 2021 he posted the request that became the only public record of an entire alliance: "Can you also add Avicia [AVO], Blue Nations United [IBT], [[shadowfall|ShadowFall]] [Shy], and TheNoLifes [TNL] in the Niflheim community alliance? Don't replace valhalla, just add it as a second alliance please :)"

The post is doubly valuable. It names [[niflheim|Niflheim]]'s four member guilds, and its second sentence records that those same guilds simultaneously belonged to the war alliance [[valhalla|Valhalla]] — direct evidence that community and war alliances ran in parallel over the same membership rather than replacing one another. Sg_Voltage answered within the hour: "Should be set, let me know if you want anyone else added to the community!"

No other source lists Niflheim's membership, and HungHung's rank within Avicia is not stated anywhere in the record.

## Sources

- Wynncraft forums thread 278112 ("the megalist"), post #146 and Sg_Voltage's reply #147, both 7 Jul 2021 (p8); Avicia level updates of 3 May 2021 (p7)

articles.title: IceResistance
articles.summary: Founder of Titans Valor in July 2017 and its owner for roughly five years, a public defender of Wynncraft’s moderators during the December 2020 crisis, and the author of a 2025 retrospective on the loss of private guild diplomacy.

infobox.label: Role
infobox.value: Founder; owner c. 2017 – c. 2022–23; Chief thereafter

articles.body:
IceResistance founded [[titans-valor|Titans Valor]] [ANO] on 2 July 2017 and opened its recruitment thread (206094) on 15 October 2017, where the guild's first hierarchy read "IceResistance | Leader of Titans Valor". Two weeks after founding he applied on the guild's behalf to the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]], describing a ten-member guild that was "Mostly community guild for the most part currently. Since we are still growing, we are not a War guild yet, although Titans Valor will always be partly community"; the alliance's roster records "Titans Valor (ANO) - Owner: IceResistance".

Against [[sheepn|Sheepn]]'s moderation pamphlet of December 2020 he defended the staff: "Moderators will not ban players without reason. Mods should also be able to participate in guilds just like any other player without being accused of bias and other slander."

[[titan-times|Titan Times]] vol. 6 (12 October 2022) marked "the long term hiatus of ANO's founder, IceResistance"; by vol. 9 (25 March 2023) he is "ANO founder and previous owner". The guild's later roster lists Calluum as Owner and IceResistance as Chief and Founder. Interviewed in vol. 20 (23 November 2025), Calluum said he took the role because "No one else wanted it when pally was stepping down" — the only public statement touching the handover, and it identifies no one further.

Returning to the forums on 2 October 2025, IceResistance argued that public channels had displaced real diplomacy: "Once upon a time, guilds had their own channels, their own Discords, their own backrooms where actual conversations happened. Alliances were formed, enemies were negotiated with, all behind closed doors. And it worked."

articles.title: Killerfish
articles.summary: Founder of Gilded Sparrows (November 2017), one of the Coalition's founder guilds, and earlier a council member of House of Sentinels.

infobox.label: Guild(s)
infobox.value: Gilded Sparrows (founder, Nov 2017); House of Sentinels (council, 2016)

infobox.label: Known for
infobox.value: Founding Gilded Sparrows, a [[Coalition]] founder guild

articles.body:
Killerfish sat on the 2016 council of House of Sentinels, the guild founded by Pyrias on 2 July 2016 and later led by Pretzule; the guild's thread (135191) lists the council as Pyrias, Pretzule, wrxryuu, Killerfish, ChaChaChaChino and 01100110111.

In November 2017 Killerfish founded the guild Gilded Sparrows, announcing it on 17 November 2017 (thread 208566) as "founded in the midst of autumn", with a single plain rule: "Be relatively active. After 3 weeks of total inactivity, you will be kicked." [[drew1011|Drew1011]] replied the same day: "Good luck with your guild ... they grow up so fast".

Gilded Sparrows became one of the founder guilds of the [[Coalition]] (created October-November 2017), alongside [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]], KingdomPhoenixes and House of Sentinels itself. Killerfish's path - Sentinels council member to founder of a fellow Coalition guild - is direct evidence that the Coalition's founding guilds were socially one circle rather than strangers in a marriage of convenience.

No later roles are attested in the written record.

articles.title: LoveLusting
articles.summary: "Queen of the Foxes" who led Kingdom Foxes in 2015 and authored the founding thread of the Valkyrie alliance in September 2015.
articles.body:
LoveLusting led [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]] (then "Kingdom of Foxes") in the guild's early years, posting on the forums under the title "Queen of the Foxes" (guild thread 89227, September 2015).

On 10 September 2015 she authored the founding thread of the [[Valkyrie]] alliance (thread 89529, "Valkyrie Alliance"), announcing an alliance formed on 2 June 2015 between Kingdom of Foxes and [[Imperial]]. The thread stated it was "not established for the purpose of war" but for "solidifying social relations between the two guilds", and described its governing body, the "Valkyrie Electorate": the member guilds' leaders deciding foreign affairs and policy by "unanimous agreement in their decision-making process". Yuno F Gasai of Imperial was the other figure named in the thread. As the author of the alliance's founding document, LoveLusting is the strongest attested candidate for Valkyrie's founder as an individual, though the thread itself assigns no such title.

Her name recurs three years later: [[drew1011|Drew1011]]'s "Federation Tribute" (thread 237070, 13 November 2018) closes with a personal acknowledgment of LoveLusting, indicating continued standing in the community through the [[federation-era|Federation era]].

articles.title: motoki317
articles.summary: Author of moto-bot, a long-running Wynncraft utility Discord bot; often confused with the separate Titans Valor guild bot, which he did not write.

infobox.label: Known for
infobox.value: moto-bot, a Wynncraft utility Discord bot (archived Jan 2024)

articles.body:
motoki317 wrote moto-bot, described in its repository as "A discord bot for Wynncraft utility commands, written in Java using JDA". It was a community tool rather than a guild one, offering Wynncraft lookups and player tracking, including a daily player-count log to a configured channel. The repository carries 576 commits and was archived read-only by its owner on 27 January 2024; the bot's first version was documented on the Wynncraft forums in thread 223425.

Two corrections attach to the name. moto-bot has been conflated with titantimes/valor, the Discord bot of [[titans-valor|Titans Valor]] that consumed an alliance-claims feed between April and December 2022 — a separate Python project published under the "titantimes" account, not motoki317's work. He is also distinct from motoki1, owner of the guild UltimateXeons in the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]] of 2017. No guild affiliation is stated for motoki317 in either repository.

articles.title: Nitrogen2Oxygen
articles.summary: Emperator of the Emperium of Wynn (2017), co-leader of DiamondDeities with Icey_Diamond, and the player who disbanded that guild on 8 January 2020, ending Horologium and the alliance wars of 2019.

infobox.label: Known for
infobox.value: Emperator of the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]] (2017); disbanding [[DiamondDeities]] (8 Jan 2020)

articles.body:
Nitrogen2Oxygen's attested career spans the era's bookends: he led its first grand experiment in mass alliance and ended its last.

In 2017 he was Emperator of the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]], the twelve-guild alliance founded on 21 April 2017: its forum thread (188024) names "Emperator Nitrogen2Oxygen" at the head of the alliance's leadership and among its Judges. The Emperium fell in October 2017; [[drew1011|Drew1011]]'s profile records a one-day successor Emperator on 15-16 October 2017.

He then co-led the guild [[DiamondDeities]] [DDT] with Icey_Diamond: the pair are listed as DDT's leaders in the founding thread of the [[aesir-pact|Aesir Pact]] (thread 227373, 2018), and Drew1011's "Federation Tribute" credits them jointly as "sincere and trusted friends" of the [[the-federation|Federation]]. On the forums he posted under the alias Cloud Man (identified in thread 236962).

On 8 January 2020 he disbanded DiamondDeities - by then a Federation and Aesir Pact veteran, a map-inferred [[SOL]] guild, a Treaty of Rodoroc signatory alongside [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]], and a founder of [[Terra]], the [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]] and [[Horologium]] (1 December 2019). The disbanding dissolved Horologium the same day and marked the end of [[the-alliance-wars-of-2019|the alliance wars of 2019]]. Most remaining members regrouped as Lux Nova the next day. His role within DDT immediately before the disbanding is not otherwise documented.

articles.title: PaladinSorcerer

articles.body:
PaladinSorcerer posted as "Pally", with a forum profile line preserved in the Wayback capture of 4 July 2021 reading "Pally — Titans Valor [ANO]/Holders of LE [HoL] — HERO — Guild: Titans Valor — Minecraft: PaladinSorcerer".

On 2 December 2020 he wrote to [[the-forum-megalist|the megalist]] arguing that [[titans-valor|Titans Valor]] was neither a war guild nor a community guild but "Mixed", citing the guild-run "Spring Fling, Summer Tournament, and Hallowynn Festival which we hosted for the entirety of the wynn community". A second post the same day carried the single most load-bearing alliance attestation of the year: "ANO is apart of the alliances Hestia (a community alliance between ANO, ESI, LXA, and PUN) and Artemis (war alliance) made up of all the current massive land holding guilds on the map". [[iceresistance|IceResistance]] replied within the hour: "umm ANO community guild FIRST / war second".

On 6 June 2021 he posted [[hestia|Hestia]]'s six-guild roster: "you can add Hestia to Titans Valor [ANO], [[emorians|Emorians]] [ERN], Lux Nova [LXA], Empire of Sindria [ESI], [[paladins-united|Paladins United]] [PUN], and [[hackforums|Hackforums]] [Hax]... We're a community alliance and have been together for about a year now."

His rank inside Titans Valor is not stated in any surviving source. [[titan-times|Titan Times]] vol. 3 (12 June 2022) lists PaladinSorcerer among recipients of the guild's Veteran Medal, "granted to distinguished former members of ANO", placing his departure before mid-2022.

articles.title: Sg_Voltage
articles.summary: Creator and maintainer of the forum megalist, Wynncraft’s community register of guilds and alliances from November 2020, and the player who deleted its alliance section in July 2022.
articles.body:
Sg_Voltage created Wynncraft forums thread 278112, "Read Before Applying To A Guild - All Currently Recruiting Guilds Megalist", on 29 November 2020, and maintained it for the next two years. The opening post set out the purpose: "I've assembled a list of every* guild which is currently recruiting along with some important stats... My goal is to be able to make sure every guild gets the chance to shine and every player can get the chance to find the guild that's right for them."

The list lived in a Google Sheet edited by the guilds themselves — "send me a message with your Gmail and I'll give you editing permission" — which is why its rosters did not survive when the sheet went down. Forum administrator colin350 pinned the thread on 17 January 2021 after Sg_Voltage committed to weekly updates.

One column of that sheet recorded alliances, and it became the era's register of record: nearly every dated alliance roster of 2020–22 traces to a post asking Sg_Voltage to update it. On 7 July 2022 he ended it, replying to a correction with "For alliance information, it's supposed to be updated by the guilds themselves... I don't care to follow guild drama", then: "You know what, on second thought I'm just going to delete that section. If it's not updated regularly it's not really useful anyways." No public alliance roster has been published since.

No guild is recorded for Sg_Voltage. His forum profile in the Wayback capture of 4 July 2021 shows a CHAMPION rank, the custom title "1.18 was the best update, don't @me", and no guild field at all — fitting for the community's neutral registrar, though whether the omission was deliberate is unknown.

articles.title: Sheepn
articles.summary: Member of Diablo [DXI] and author of "Guild Moderators" (18 December 2020), the pamphlet that made the Artemis war a public legitimacy dispute and preserved the roster of the coalition that became Goose.
articles.body:
On 18 December 2020 Sheepn, then of Diablo [DXI], opened thread 279337, "Guild Moderators" — the best-documented political flashpoint between the ignition of the war against [[artemis|Artemis]] and the naming of [[goose|Goose]] a month later. Its opening sentence supplies the era's clearest framing of the conflict: "there is currently an ongoing large-scale conflict between Artemis, the map-holder alliance, and a currently unnamed group of anti-Artemis guilds."

The complaint was that "a moderator affiliated with a major Artemis guild" had banned two prominent members of the leading anti-Artemis guild for macro use, when the numpad spamming they described was "publicly known to be NOT bannable and allowed by moderation". The thread's thesis was structural rather than personal: "The root of the problem boils down to the moderation team failing to adapt to the modern way guilds operate even though many Moderators come from guilds, and a lack of set-in-stone rules for guilds related issues." Sheepn closed with a request not to "name drop or harass the moderator involved".

The replies made the thread a record in itself. [[iceresistance|IceResistance]] of [[titans-valor|Titans Valor]] answered that "Moderators will not ban players without reason"; Carrie of [[paladins-united|Paladins United]] located the real fault in the team's "lack of communication, being on the same page"; Miles_ questioned a rule enforceable only when players incriminate themselves. Read together with the guild tags of its participants, the thread also preserves the membership of the then-unnamed coalition — Diablo, Eden, [[avicia|Avicia]], HICH, Bovemists, Lily Pad, Ultra Violet, [[emorians|Emorians]], The Dark Phoenix, Paladins United and [[imperial|Imperial]] — and places [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]] and Titans Valor in Artemis.

articles.title: simplyinfinity_
articles.summary: Leader of Sins of Seedia across the Emperium, Aesir Pact and Federation years; credited as the first to accept the merger proposal that created the Federation.

infobox.label: Known for

articles.body:
simplyinfinity_ led the guild [[sins-of-seedia|Sins of Seedia]] [SDU] through several political generations of the late 2010s.

The earliest attestation is the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]] roster of April 2017 (thread 188024): among the alliance's twelve member guilds, Sins of Seedia is listed with simplyinfinity_ as its leader, under Emperator [[nitrogen2oxygen|Nitrogen2Oxygen]].

In June 2018 simplyinfinity_ ("Simply") appears again, alongside Shy_Phoenix, as Sins of Seedia's leadership in the founding thread of the [[aesir-pact|Aesir Pact]] (thread 227373), the four-guild pact with [[Fantasy]] ([[viaire|Viaire]], SpaseCow), IceBlue Team ([[vmark03|Vmark03]], Mpr100) and [[DiamondDeities]] (Nitrogen2Oxygen, Icey_Diamond).

Between those two dates falls the contribution for which [[drew1011|Drew1011]]'s "Federation Tribute" (thread 237070, 13 November 2018) credits simplyinfinity_: being the "first to consider and accept the proposal of merging alliances" - the February 2018 merger of the [[Coalition]] remnant and [[war-syndicate|War Syndicate]] that created the [[the-federation|Federation]]. Sins of Seedia later left the Federation with the other Aesir guilds on 10 November 2018, the departure described by a witness as "essentially ending it"; no source attributes that exit to simplyinfinity_ personally.

articles.title: Slayne
articles.summary: Federation-circle player remembered for a November 2018 forum post claiming he co-created Alliance Alliance - and thereby, indirectly, the Federation itself.
articles.body:
Slayne appears in the written record of the [[federation-era|Federation era]]. [[drew1011|Drew1011]]'s "Federation Tribute" (thread 237070, 13 November 2018) credits him among the [[the-federation|Federation]]'s contributors for loyalty and straightforwardness.

On page 3 of the same thread (post #45, 14 November 2018, posted under the forum title "Tenacious Snuggles") Slayne made the claim for which he is chiefly remembered: "In a way, you could say that I created Fed because I (along with some others) created Double AA. Take that drew! Owait. Im also drew. Damn it".

"Double AA" is [[alliance-alliance|Alliance Alliance]], whose split from the [[Coalition]] on 16 February 2018 triggered the merger of the Coalition remnant and [[war-syndicate|War Syndicate]] that created the Federation - so the post asserts a causal founder's role, jokingly aimed at Drew1011. It is a claim, not an attested founding record: no other source names Alliance Alliance's creators, none contradicts Slayne, and his own wording ("along with some others") leaves the rest of the founding circle unnamed. It stands as the only first-person account of AA's creation.

No guild affiliation for Slayne is recorded in the era's sources.

articles.title: TheDarkSoul
articles.summary: Owner of the war guild HackForums from its creation on 24 December 2014, presiding over its 2016-17 territorial hegemony of up to roughly 350 territories.
articles.body:
TheDarkSoul owned the guild [[HackForums]] [Hax]. The guild's recruitment thread (109319) carried the line "Active Guild Since: 12/24/14 - Owner: TheDarkSoul" in every recovered version, and described the guild plainly: "This is a war guild, guild wars are expected of you upon joining." Day-to-day forum-keeping fell to officers such as Mrussell75 and Christinel8; TheDarkSoul's own written footprint is minimal, and the ownership line is essentially his entire attested record.

Under his ownership HackForums became the dominant territorial power of the pre-[[Coalition]] era. An API leaderboard capture of 23 September 2016 shows Hax holding 146 of roughly 332 territories, far ahead of any rival; a March 2017 complaint thread (179383) put its holdings at "100+ territories"; a May 2017 thread attests more than 300; and a 2020 recollection by Lego_DW places the peak "closer to 350". The hegemony ended in the Coalition-era wars of late 2017 and [[the-wipe-of-hackforums|the wipe of HackForums]] in February 2018.

No written source records when, or whether, his ownership ended.

articles.title: TherapueticLiz
articles.summary: Long-serving member and later owner of Sins of Seedia, who on 26 June 2022 posted Cucumber Company’s fourteen-guild roster to the forum megalist — the last public alliance roster ever recorded.

articles.body:

Kind of sad to see it end but nothing ever truly lasts."

On 26 June 2022 came the post that closed the public record. Correcting [[the-forum-megalist|the megalist]] — "Don't mean to necro, but a majority of the alliance info is incorrect. here's a list in case you want to update it" — the post set out [[cucumber-company|Cucumber Company]]'s fourteen guilds: [[aequitas|Aequitas]], [[titans-valor|Titans Valor]], [[avicia|Avicia]], Blacklisted, KongoBoys, Empire of Sindria, Gang of Fools, [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]], The Clowns, Nefarious Ravens, Sins of Seedia, [[the-aquarium|The Aquarium]], Wynn Legacy and [[profession-heaven|Profession Heaven]]. The same post recorded the retreat from the forums in miniature: "my guild has ceased recruiting through forums. We have an application process within our discord as many other guilds now do."

She is also credited with the video "SMTN ELSE SLANDER" of 3 October 2022, made after the bloc renamed itself [[smtn-elf|smtn elf]] — leaving her chronicler of both the roster and its successor's mockery. As of September 2026 the Wynncraft API records her as Sins of Seedia's owner.

articles.title: urbymine
articles.summary: Former Chief of Avicia whose one-line megalist post of 1 February 2021 dates the defection of IceBlue Team, ShadowFall and TheNoLifes from Artemis to Goose.
articles.body:
On 1 February 2021 urbymine posted to [[the-forum-megalist|the megalist]]: "Just a smol update that i noticed: BNU(IBT), SHY and TNL are all goose now." The single line dates the defection of IceBlue Team, [[shadowfall|ShadowFall]] and TheNoLifes from [[artemis|Artemis]] to [[goose|Goose]] — ShadowFall having held an Artemis leadership seat under [[goulartjj|GoulartJJ]] eleven months earlier. In the same post he suggested the maintainer adopt "a google form system for guilds to request changes/additions to the list".

Three weeks later, posting under the forum title "Former Chief of Avicia", he argued in the thread "The Issue With 1.20 Guild Wars" that the alliance-dominated war system was working as designed: "we just have to accept that wars are a team-based effort, not just within your own guild but in that it requires you to reach out to other guilds to make progress on the map... it adds a whole new layer to guildwars in the form of diplomacy... it actively discourages selfish and arrogant guilds". He also correctly diagnosed the mechanic behind the era's complaints about escalating attack costs — "This is probably caused by the pity limit" — while agreeing that resource-poor regions were hard to campaign in.

His dates as an [[avicia|Avicia]] Chief are not recorded.

articles.title: Yugito
articles.summary: Eden’s leader through the Artemis–Goose war, who opened the guild’s forum thread in January 2020 and presided over its Roman-styled Senate; by 2025 the guild lists him as a Dux.
articles.body:
Yugito opened Eden's recruitment thread (260434) on 1 January 2020 and is recorded as the guild's leader through the [[artemis|Artemis]]–[[goose|Goose]] war. Eden appears among the anti-Artemis guilds in [[sheepn|Sheepn]]'s "Guild Moderators" thread of December 2020, and was confirmed inside Goose on 19 January 2021 when Lev98bug asked [[the-forum-megalist|the megalist]] to "add Eden is in Goose if you could add that :))". The research record names Lev98bug as a Chief, with Asthae and Rothboy among the guild's senior figures.

Eden set aside the in-game ranks entirely for a Roman apparatus, described in its own thread: an Agora containing every member, a Legion as "our military force", and a Senate of Consuls, Duxes and Senates that "discusses and votes on decisions that largely impact the empire". Above them sat an Emperor whose only formal power was to veto the Senate, and who could be replaced only when "the current Emperor steps down and hands over their powers".

Eden was at some point deposed from within. The entire public record of the coup is one sentence in a guild application quoted on the Titans Valor thread on 16 April 2023, in which xK6TA wrote: "I was a part of Eden when it was #1 and slightly after it got couped." No source names its actors or its date, and since Eden never won a guild season it is unclear what "#1" refers to. By the guild thread's January 2025 revision, FadeDave is listed as Emperor, Asthae as Consul, and Yugito as one of six Duxes.

articles.title: Guild seasons
articles.summary: The competitive season system added in patch 1.20.3 (5 July 2021): guilds earn Season Rating by holding and attacking territories, with rewards and territory resets every season. Seasons became the calendar by which the community dated its own history, and their winners are the cleanest continuous record of guild dominance.

infobox.label: Mechanic
infobox.value: Season Rating (SR) from holding and attacking territories

infobox.label: Season length
infobox.value: 'Every 3 months or so' as announced; shortened to 1.5-2 months in 1.20.4

articles.body:
Guild seasons were introduced in patch 1.20.3, released on 5 July 2021, building on the [[territory-warfare|territory warfare]] rework of version 1.20 'Gavel Reborn' (20 January 2021).

Under the system, guilds earn Season Rating (SR) by holding and attacking territories. Territories generate SR every five seconds on a sliding scale that penalises large claims - the fifth territory a guild holds yields only 80 per cent of its nominal rate, and the twenty-second and beyond only 20 per cent - while each successful capture awards a flat amount. At each season's end every territory is reset to the placeholder guild Nobody [None] with its defences, upgrades and treasury stripped, and rewards are distributed by SR leaderboard ranking and by SR thresholds: guild capes, seasonal banners, badges, tomes, emeralds, XP boosts, bank slots, and a crown cosmetic for the #1 guild. The design deliberately spread rewards beyond the top competitive guilds. The same patch reduced war team size from 6 to 5, adjusted tax caps and added territory loadouts. Seasons were announced as running 'every 3 months or so'; the 1.20.4 changelog retargeted them to 1.5-2 months, which is why later seasons carry lower winning ratings.

A three-day Season 0 ran from 5 to 7 July 2021 as a test, with no banner reward; the numbered competition began with Season 1 on 9 July 2021.

## Seasons as the community's calendar

Seasons quickly became the community's calendar, and Titan Times vol. 1 confirms they were fought as alliances: 'our first season being a part of the new Cucumber Company war alliance'. articles.title: The Diplomacy update
articles.summary: Wynncraft's in-game guild ally system, introduced in version 1.20 (2021). Allying is a game-mechanical relationship — an ally tax rate, and from 2026 the ability for allied guilds to run Guild Raids together — rather than a political alliance, though from June 2026 its events became the first machine-readable record of guild relationships.

articles.body:
Wynncraft has had an in-game guild ally system since version 1.20 'Gavel Reborn' (20 January 2021). Allying is a game-mechanical status rather than a declaration: it interacts with the [[territory-warfare|territory system]] through the ally tax rate charged on an allied guild's territories, and a Diplomacy menu in the guild UI lists a guild's allies (up to 16, per the Sequoia mod's snapshot feature). Setting a guild as an ally does not indicate a political alliance — allied guilds may be rivals or recent belligerents — and no source in the chronicle records the in-game menu mattering to the [[the-realignment-era|realignment-era]] or [[private-diplomacy-era|private-diplomacy-era]] blocs.

What the system is chiefly for became explicit in 2026. Version 2.2.1 (12 June 2026) added the change 'Guild Allies can now do Guild Raids together', which is the point of the feature as it is used: two guilds register as allies so that their members can run guild raids as one group. (The chronicle database dates this feature to version 2.2.2 of 10 July 2026; the wiki's changelogs attribute it to 2.2.1 — the conflict is noted here, with the wiki's own patch notes favoured.)

The same month, [[Sequoia]]'s open-source client mod began parsing the in-game 'formed/revoked an alliance with' chat broadcasts (commit of 12 June 2026), capturing [[first-machine-recorded-alliances|the first machine-recorded alliance events]] in guild history — including the broadcast of [[GaztheCat]], Sequoia's owner, revoking Sequoia's ally registration with Chiefs Of Corkus. From 30 July 2026 the mod auto-snapshots the Diplomacy menu to Sequoia's private backend, a growing machine-readable archive that is not publicly accessible. The official API still exposes no alliance field (verified 2 September 2026), so the in-game record remains readable only through such tooling — and what it shows is which guilds were registered as allies, not which guilds were politically aligned.

- Official Wynncraft API v3/guild (checked 2 Sep 2026): no alliance field

articles.summary: Wynncraft version 1.18, the Economy Update, released 18 January 2019: professions, crafting and an in-game trade market. It reshaped the economy that funded guilds but left war mechanics essentially untouched.

articles.body:
Version 1.18, officially titled 'The Economy Update', was released on 18 January 2019 — between the [[the-federation-dies|Federation's fall]] and the founding of [[Luna]], in the middle of [[the-alliance-wars-of-2019|the alliance wars of 2019]].

Its focus was the player economy rather than warfare: it introduced the professions system (gathering and crafting), and the official announcement promised an in-game trade market ('You'll be able to purchase/sell anything easily'). On the guild side its recorded contribution is cosmetic — guild banners were introduced in 1.18, replacing what the wiki calls 'the Mysterious Potatoes riddle'.

None of the sources consulted record changes to the guild war system itself in 1.18. The economy-and-war rework that transformed [[territory-warfare|territory warfare]] — war towers, guild resource production, trade routes and taxation — came two years later, in version 1.20 'Gavel Reborn' (20 January 2021), which also laid the groundwork for [[guild-seasons|Guild seasons]] and the in-game ally system (see [[the-diplomacy-update|The Diplomacy update]]).

articles.title: The Guild Update
articles.summary: Guilds and guild wars were introduced to Wynncraft in version 1.13, the Wynnter Update, released on 22 December 2014 — the starting point of all guild warfare history.
articles.body:
Guilds were introduced to Wynncraft in version 1.13 — the 'Wynnter Update' — released on 22 December 2014, and guild wars have existed since the same update. Per the official wiki, guilds 'were originally going to just be permanent parties'; instead they became territorial powers, and the war system introduced here is the one under which the entire [[early-guild-era|early guild era]] and [[federation-era|Federation era]] were fought.

In the original system, players accessed the Guild Master through a teleporter in Troms (moved to the Guild Hall in the 1.14 Gavel expansion of 2015). The 1.13-era war mechanics — including mob-wave wars fought on dedicated war servers, with territories generating XP — survived with incremental changes for six years, until the ground-up rework in version 1.20 'Gavel Reborn' (20 January 2021; see [[territory-warfare|Territory warfare]] and [[guild-seasons|Guild seasons]]).

Every era article on this wiki descends from this update: the first territorial powers of 2015–2016, the [[HackForums]] dominance, and everything after (see [[history-of-wynncraft-guild-warfare|History of Wynncraft guild warfare]]).
